concern: 25C79 Kuga - Powertrain Control Module Software Update
defect: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 25C79 may not have been delivered properly and the Powertrain Control Module software may deliver lower power output than intended.
remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module software and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

concern: Rear lid gas strut
defect: For affected vehicles applying excess pressure to open the rear lid to its end position may cause the upper ball socket to detach from the gas strut allowing the rear lid to fall without restraint as one gas strut alone cannot hold it open.
remedy: The gas struts of the rear lid will be checked and if necessary replaced.

concern: Rework of steering damper
defect: For certain machines the steering damper screw connection may become loose from the mounting adapter.
remedy: Application of Loctite thread lock to mounting adapter and increase torque value.

concern: Takata Non-Desiccated Driver Airbags - Cadillac BLS (Zone C)
defect: On affected vehicles the driver air bag inflator may experience an alteration over time which could lead to overaggressive combustion in the event of airbag deployment. This condition could create excessive internal pressure resulting in the body of the inflator rupturing upon deployment leading…
remedy: Replace the driver air bag module assembly.

concern: 69C8 - Checking seat belts Terramar and Raval
defect: On affected vehicles driver and / or passenger seat belt may not be correctly secured to the lower anchor point on the B-pillar.
remedy: Check the seat belt fastening and replace if necessary.

concern: 3008v3- Wrong Front bumper installed BEV instead of MHEV.
defect: On affected vehicles air defelectors may have been installed incorrectly to the front bumbper grille which can affect the airflow required for cooling the engine and 48V battery system
remedy: Check and remove the defelectors if present.

concern: SRL260907 – ECO-SCHWRC - Replace holders for left and right fenders at front axle.

The affected front-axle fender is supported and positioned by a carrier that is firmly connected to the vehicle frame. Due to an…
remedy: As part of the planned recall campaign we intend to replace the rear fender holders on the front axle of the potentially affected vehicles.

concern: 166- PANORAMIC ROOF WINDOW BREAKAGE
defect: For affected vehicles that following breakage of the outer glass pane of the panoramic roof window the remaining inner pane may lose retention and become detached from the vehicle.
remedy: An enhanced retention bracket system will be installed on affected panoramic roof windows. Customers who are unable to immediately present their vehicle for repair will be provided with instructions for an interim precautionary measure.

concern: Multi Vehicle Line: Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR) Unexpected Activation / Deactivation
defect: Affected vehicles have been identified where the Traffic Sign Recognition and Driver Alert System are being turned on or off without the expected notification to the driver.
remedy: Update the vehicles configuration and Software.

concern: Transit Custom - Potential Touch Condition Between Bulkhead Bolt And Fuel Tank – Product Safety Recall
defect: On affected vehicles there may be insufficient clearance between a bulkhead bolt and the fuel tank which could cause damage over time and lead to a fuel leak.
remedy: Replace the bulkhead bolt.

concern: Replacing the Windscreen J01 J05
defect: For affected vehicles the interior mirror mounting plate may not have been bonded to the windscreen sufficiently. The rear view mirror could become partially or even completely detached from the windshield.
remedy: The windscreen (including interior mirror mounting) will be replaced.

concern: Cube (Z12) Driver Airbag
defect: For affected vehicles the Driver's Airbag module may have been incorrectly assembled during production. In this condition the driver’s airbag inflator module may detach from the steering wheel.
remedy: Check and replace driver airbag if necessary.

concern: 26S56 Mustang Mach E – Rear Quarter Glass Moulding
defect: On affected vehicles the rear quarter glass trim moulding can become detached while driving.
remedy: The manufacturer is currently working on part availability. Once available they will inform owners so they can contact their dealer to schedule an appointment. If owners experience the issue in the meantime they should contact their dealer.

concern: Puma – Exhaust system cold end replacement – Compliance Recall
defect: On affected vehicles the incorrect exhaust system cold end may have been fitted during production.
remedy: Replace the cold end of the exhaust system.

concern: Instrument Cluster Malfunction - Risk of Crash
defect: On affected vehicles depending on driver usage of USB and Bluetooth connections a communication failure or memory leak may occur within the instrument cluster. This condition can cause the cluster to temporarily reset freeze or become persistently blank. Physical telltales will continue to…
remedy: Install modified software via an over-the-air (OTA) update.

concern: SRPC2603 - Drive Shaft Joint
defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain 4MATIC E-Class (213 platform) S-Class Coupé (217 platform) S-Class (222 platform) E-Class Coupe/Convertible (238 platform) GLC (253 platform) and CLS (257 platform) vehicles increased wear of the universal joint on the drive shaft might occur.
remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the drive shaft on the affected vehicles and replace it if necessary.

concern: 26S62 Kuga – EDS Wiring touch
defect: Affected vehicles may have a touch condition between a fixing screw and push nut to the Instrument Panel (IP) wiring harness. If the vehicle’s wiring is damaged different warning messages may appear depending on which wire is affected. These could include warnings for the airbag system eCall…
remedy: Inspect and reposition wiring harness to increase clearance and protect surfaces and if necessary repair or replace the instrument panel wiring harness.

concern: Installation of the Heat Shield
defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain GLE (167 platform) vehicles with OM654 and hybrid drive a heat shield in the firewall area might not be installed according to specification.
remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the heat shield and the fuel line on the affected vehicles and rework it if necessary.

concern: The vehicle may have incorrectly secured front seat belt anchor points
defect: Affected vehicles may have incorrectly secured front seat belt anchor points. This may result in a lack of protection in the event of a vehicle collision.
remedy: A modification will be applied to the seat belt anchor area to rectify the concern

concern: L87 Engine Loss of Propulsion
defect: The connecting rod and/or crankshaft engine components in these vehicles may have manufacturing defects that can lead to engine damage and engine failure. If the engine fails while driving the vehicle will lose propulsion increasing the risk of a crash.
remedy: Dealers will inspect the engine. If the vehicle fails the inspection procedure the engine will be repaired or replaced. Vehicles that pass inspection will be provided a higher viscosity oil which will also require a new oil fill cap identifying the new required oil grade an oil filter replacement…

concern: L87 Engine Loss of Propulsion

remedy: Dealers will inspect the engine. If the vehicle fails the inspection procedure the engine will be repaired or replaced. concern: Some vehicles may have a potential issue with one module within the high voltage battery which may have been manufactured with misaligned electrodes.
defect: Affected vehicles may contain a suspect HV (high voltage) battery module manufactured by the supplier during a specific production period. It is recommended that the vehicle is to be parked in a well ventilated area. The vehicle can be used as normal.
remedy: Replacement of the high voltage battery module will be carried out.

concern: 26C32 Mustang - Windshield Wipers and Washer System Potentially Inoperative During Freezing Temperatures
defect: On affected vehicles during freezing temperatures or below the windshield wipers may become inoperative. In other cases the windshield wipers may operate only at the high-speed setting and an inoperative windshield washer system may prevent washer fluid from being effectively used to clean the…
remedy: Inspect the windshield wiper system and replace the wiper motor if necessary.

concern: Identification plate wrong value
defect: Affected vehicles have been delivered with missing labels that carry information about the manufacturer’s representative and wrongly stamped chassis plates.
remedy: Replace the incorrect chassis plate and install the missing information label.

concern: Replacing TAKATA driver airbag
defect: On affected vehicles in the event of an accident in which the airbag is deployed the front airbag gas generator could burst sending metal fragments into the vehicle. This could cause serious harm or fatal injuries to the driver and their passengers.
remedy: Replace the front airbag on the driver side.

concern: Ignition lock may fail
defect: In affected machines a component of the ignition steering-lock assembly may in isolated cases develop vibration induced wear which can lead to loss of electrical contact and consequently to loss of ignition. If ignition is interrupted the engine will stop and all electrical functions (lighting…
remedy: Update software and check function of ignition lock

concern: 165-ISOFIX
defect: For certain vehicles the ISOFIX mountings may have inadequate weld seams at the attachment points. In the event of a vehicle crash the forces transmitted through a child seat attached to the ISOFIX anchorages may cause the bracket to fracture resulting in an increased risk of injury to the child.
remedy: Vehicle owners are instructed not to use the ISOFIX attachment points until a technical inspection and if necessary a retrofit or repair has been carried out by an authorised dealer. Vehicles that pass the inspection may continue to be used; vehicles that fail will be retrofitted accordingly.

concern: Astra L - VSM software- SLI performance.
defect: Affected vehicles may have Vehicle Supervision Module (VSM) software that displays incorrect speed-limit indications resulting in non-compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
remedy: Update the VSM software and update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-The-Air at the dealer if necessary.

concern: Title of Recall Rear Door Outside Handle replacement on Urban Cruiser
defect: During the manufacturing process of the rear outer door handle an insufficient amount of grease may have been applied to components of the internal linkage. As a result corrosion may develop on an internal spring over time. Which may cause it to bind or seize.
remedy: Replacement of the rear door handles

concern: 26S35 – Ranger – Engine failure
defect: On affected vehicles it may be possible that one or more engine camshaft roller finger followers were not properly installed at the time of assembly. An improperly installed camshaft roller finger follower may result in engine failure resulting in a no-start condition or a loss of motive power.
remedy: Replace the engine.

concern: 26S10 - Kuga Ranger - Potential Exhaust Gas Recirculation Valve Failure
defect: On affected vehicles the Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) valve may fail leading to weak acceleration engine vibration a no start condition or a loss of power.
remedy: Replace the EGR valve.

concern: Inspect Aguti ISOFIX bracket and replace if necessary
defect: For affected vehicles with a rear seat equipped with an ISOFIX attachment system the welded joints of the ISOFIX attachment points may have been manufactured with a defect and could fail in the event of an accident.
remedy: Users are asked to stop using ISOFIX connection points to attach child seats with immediate effect. Dealers or garages will inspect and if necessary replace the ISOFIX bracket.

concern: Range Rover (L405) Front Suspension Knuckle Crack – Incorrect Repair
defect: For affected vehicles the repair procedure for a prior safety recall was incorrect. As a result the front suspension knuckles have been replaced with those of an incorrect specification.
remedy: Vehicles will have both front suspension knuckles replaced.

concern: SRPC-2608 Electric drive unit power electronics
defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that in certain CLA (174 platform) and GLB (244 platform) vehicles the circuit board for the power electronics of the rear electric drive unit might not meet the specifications.
remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the rear axle.

concern: Kia EV6 HV Battery Cell Misalignment
defect: Due to a quality deviation by the supplier certain battery cells within the High Voltage Battery System Assembly manufactured in limited production periods may have been produced with a misaligned electrode. A misaligned electrode may over time result in an internal short circuit in certain…
remedy: If the HV battery State of Health is greater than 90% Kia UK will replace the defective module in the pack if 90% or lower the complete battery pack assembly will be replaced.

concern: BALL PIN NOT HARDENED
defect: Following a process carried out by the supplier of the ball joints mounted on the steering transverse tie rod [track rod tube] and in order to protect end customers and guarantee the highest quality standards IVECO has decided to launch a recall campaign.
remedy: The remedy is to replace the track rod assembly with new ball joint ends OR drag link assembly depending on vehicle configuration.

concern: Fuel Hose Detached Under Fuel Tank

concern: 26S57 Explorer – Panoramic Roof Partial Detachment
defect: Affected vehicles may have a panoramic roof with an improper adhesion bond. This could result in wind noise water leak or separation from the vehicle.
remedy: Test the adhesion bonding of the panoramic roof. and replace if necessary

concern: Bevel Gear installed with Wrong Ratio

concern: BCM software update – Black screen

concern: Impairment of display messages in the instrument cluster (ICUC Gen6) on B2E vehicles

concern: Replacement of LH & RH Rear Outside Door Handles

remedy: Replace the outer rear door handles.

concern: Correct speed restriction

remedy: Adjust the software in various control units.

concern: Replacement of rear brake caliper
defect: On affected motorcycles under certain riding conditions the rear brake caliper may be subjected to excessive stress which in the worst case can lead to the rear brake caliper breaking.
remedy: Replace the rear brake caliper including the caliper bracket on all affected motorcycles.

concern: Rear Brake Caliper Replacement
defect: On affected motorcycles under certain riding conditions the rear brake caliper may be subjected to excessive stress which in the worst case can lead to the rear brake caliper breaking.
remedy: Replace the rear brake caliper including the caliper bracket on all affected motorcycles.

concern: Checking lap belt tensioner
defect: On affected vehicles the seat belt webbing may not be connected correctly to the vehicle's load-bearing structure meaning it would not be able to restrain the occupant in the event of an accident.
remedy: Check the affected seat belt and replace if necessary.

concern: SRC260707 – RC2602 – Check replace the link rod on the upper supporting joint
defect: As part of our continuous product monitoring we have identified that a defined production batch of the link rod for the upper supporting joint has not acquired the required material hardness in the production process due to insufficient inductive hardening. concern: SRC260720 – RC2603 – Replacment of the IAB brake actuator on the rear axle

concern: SRC260709 – RC2502 – Failure of turn signal lamp in main headlamp
defect: As part of our continuous product monitoring we have identified that due to insufficient contact pressure from the front turn signal indicator socket inside the headlamp unit loss of contact may occur during driving operation. As a consequence of the loss of contact thermal damage may occur on the…
remedy: As part of the planned product safety recall the bulb holders of the turn signal lamps of both main headlamps on the potentially affected vehicles will be checked and replaced if found to be defective.

concern: Hose topic

concern: Kia PV5 Composite Bonnet Recall
defect: Due to changes in production some areas have uneven material and strength to improve the bonnets outer appearance. As a result if the vehicle impacts a pedestrian the risk of injury may be higher.
remedy: Check the LOT number of the bonnet replace if in the affected range.

concern: Kia PV5 Seat Belt Retaining Bolts
defect: Front & 2nd row (left & right side) seat belt retaining bolts are not correctly fastened on some vehicles. If affected the seat belt restraint is compromised and there is a chance of an increase in passenger injury during a collision.
remedy: Check all seat belt retaining bolts & apply the correct torque setting.

concern: 26C36 - Transit – Vehicle Identification Number Label Missing Mandatory Weight Information
defect: On affected vehicles the B-pillar label displays the Vehicle Identification Number but the fields for mandatory vehicle weight information may be blank.
remedy: Remove the existing label clean the area and install a new replacement displaying the correct mandatory information.

concern: Vehicle Total upgrade via sVDS 2.0
defect: It has come to our attention that your vehicle is part of a very small number of smart #5 vehicles of which under very specific circumstances the braking software may underperform and lead to unexpected skidding on specific surfaces in icy or wet weather conditions. concern: 25S75 Cross Carline - Low Pressure Fuel Pump Potential Failure
defect: Affected vehicles may have an issue with the fuel lift pump that could cause the engine to stall.
remedy: Update the Power Control Module software.

concern: 26S49 – Transit and Transit/Tourneo Custom – Automatic Transmission Snap Ring
defect: Affected vehicles may have an Electronic One-Way Clutch Assembly built with an unseated snap ring which may lead to a sudden and unexpected loss of forward or reverse movement.
remedy: Disassemble the transmission to check the snap ring is correctly seated and replace any necessary parts.

concern: INTERSTAR XDD/XDE Emissions Label

remedy: Replace the Emissions Label with the correct European specification label.

defect: On affected vehicles when driving with the advanced full beam assist function a deviation of the light distribution of the Matrix Beam headlights occurs resulting in glare for both the vehicle in front and the oncoming vehicle.

concern: Adaption Measure for the Emission Control System R60 / R61 N47T

concern: The vehicle three-way coolant valve may become defective during the vehicle operation.

remedy: Replacement of the three way coolant valve.

concern: Kia Picanto Possible Under Bonnet Fuel Leak
defect: Fuel leakage may occur due to contact between the fuel line and the battery tray cable. For affected cars this may lead to damage of the fuel line and the risk of a fuel leak.
remedy: Carry out a visual inspection pipe if no damage re-route and secure the pipe. If damaged replace the pipe and re-route.

concern: Inspect Aguti ISOFIX bracket and replace if necessary
defect: On affected vehicles the welded connection of the ISOFIX anchorage points may have been manufactured incorrectly. In very isolated cases it cannot be completely ruled out that the ISOFIX brackets could break in the event of a rear-end collision or vehicle crash.
remedy: The ISOFIX system will be inspected and replaced if necessary.

concern: Lift recall
defect: Under certain conditions the platform lift motor could remain energised and move unintentionally despite the lift operator commanding the lift to stop increasing the risk of injury to the lift occupant or others in the vicinity.
remedy: Install two diodes within the lift electrical system wiring to prevent voltage from a failed contactor maintaining a closed condition and to ensure proper de-energisation of the motor contactor when the operator commands the lift to stop.

concern: Replace the Brake Master Cylinders
defect: On affected vehicles in a combination of very specific conditions the seal within one of the brake master cylinders can deform. This can lead to brake fluid not being released back into the reservoir causing drag and leading to an increase in temperature increasing the risk of a localised fire.
remedy: The revised remedy parts are not yet available. Aston Martin will contact owners to schedule a time date and location for brake master cylinder replacement when parts are available.

concern: SRL260623 – KUGESPU – Replace tie rod

concern: Engine Management System (EMS) software Update

remedy: Install updated NOx monitoring software.

concern: SRL260702 – 2605U46W07 – Replace tie rod

It cannot be…
remedy: As part of our planned recall campaign and as a precautionary measure we want to check whether insufficiently hardened components were installed in the potentially affected vehicles. Insufficiently hardened components will be replaced as part of the check.

concern: Vehicle configuration (Proxi) update on certain Toyota Proace Max BEV
defect: For certain vehicles the Body Control Module (BCM) is not properly configured to detect turn signal lamp failures. As a result if a bulb fails the BCM does not recognize the fault and fails to activate a mandatory tell-tale and warning to the driver.
remedy: Software update to Body Control Module (BCM)

concern: SRL260522 – AGM-BATT – Check printed circuit board on battery for damage
defect: As part of our continuous quality monitoring we have identified that in Actros 963 Arocs 964 vehicles with integral rear area and eActros 300/400 with fleece battery (absorbent glass mat) a thermal reaction may occur due to corrosion on the ACE chip (Advanced Connected Energy). Battery data can be…
remedy: Check printed circuit board in on-board electrical system battery for damage. Replace on-board electrical system battery (after check) if necessary.

concern: Replacement front seat belt
defect: On affected vehicles a joint at the pyrotechnic inflator of the front seat belt retractors was not welded correctly presenting a risk of vehicle occupants being injured by small parts coming loose in the event of an accident.
remedy: Replace the affected seat belts.

concern: QASHQAI J12 Lithium Ion Battery

Vehicle will not return to normal function until power-latch (IGN off for approximately 30 mins and key away from vehicle).
remedy: Reprogram the Battery Management System (BMS).

concern: Replacement front seat belt
defect: On affected vehicles a joint at the pyrotechnic inflator of the front seat belt retractors was not welded correctly presenting a risk of vehicle occupants being injured by small parts coming loose in the event of an accident.

concern: CMA Cell Modules

concern: C Evolution wiring harness repair

remedy: Update drive module software and dashboard display software

concern: Vauxhall Corsa D Passenger Airbag
defect: On affected vehicles the passenger front airbag may not deploy properly in the event of a collision.
remedy: On affected vehicles the passenger front air bag will be replaced.

concern: Citroen Relay (X250) Wrong weight values on manufacturer plate
defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a metal Manufacturer plate located in the engine compartment that shows the wrong weight values. This can lead to a non-compliance to regulatory requirements.
remedy: Check and replace the metal Manufacturer plate.

concern: Peugeot Boxer (X250) Wrong weight values on Manufacturer Plate
defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a metal Manufacturer plate located in the engine compartment that shows the wrong weight values. This can lead to a non-compliance to regulatory requirements.
remedy: Check and replace the metal Manufacturer plate.

concern: 24C28 - Transit Courier – Front right seat built with incorrect side airbag
defect: Affected vehicles have been fitted with an incorrect side airbag on the front right seat. There is no significant increase in severity of harm. In the case of a side impact airbag performance still meets ECE135 and ECE95 requirements.
remedy: Replace the front right-side airbag.

concern: Replace the Passenger Airbag
defect: On certain vehicles the passenger airbag may not have had the seam sewn according to the specifications.
remedy: Replacement of the passenger airbag

concern: Control unit for reverser
defect: On affected vehicles the reverser control unit may be insufficiently sealed allowing moisture to lead to corrosion of the internal electrical contacts.
remedy: On affected vehicles the reverser control unit will be permanently disconnected as an intermediate measure. The control unit will then be replaced by an improved part once available.

concern: Improper programming of transmission shift control system
defect: On affected machines there is a risk that the motorcycle may shift to neutral when the rider attempts to shift from 1st to 2nd gear due to improper programming of the shift control system.
remedy: Update the shift control system with modified software.

concern: SRL240710 - LEIT-SCHEU Check wiring harness routing
defect: The retrofitted DVS camera / sensor wiring harness along the chassis/cab frame may have been carried out incorrectly. As a result of an incorrectly installed DVS retrofitting scorching damage could occur in the area of the transition from the frame to the cab (swan neck) due to chafing of the…
remedy: As part of the planned field measure we will check the DVS retrofit was carried out on behalf of DTUK as to whether the retrofitting of the cables was carried out in accordance with the specifications in WIS and the Bodybuilder Guideline and therefore if the chassis/cab frame wiring harness is…

concern: Luggage Compartment Lashing Rail G01 F97
defect: On affected vehicles the screw connection for the luggage lashing rails may not withstand the forces in situations of a rear end impact. This may result in the lashing rail to not crumple as expected in these situations.
remedy: On affected vehicles the luggage lashing rail screws will be replaced along with additional washers.

concern: DS3 Crossback Steering Gear Pinion
defect: On affected vehicles the steering rack fitted may not conform to specification and result in an increased force to rotate the steering wheel.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the steering rack will be replaced.

concern: Vauxhall Mokka Steering Gear Pinion.
defect: On affected vehicles the steering rack fitted may not conform to specification and result in an increased force to rotate the steering wheel.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the steering rack will be replaced.

concern: Leaking of GYTR racing fuel cap
defect: On affected motorcycles when the GYTR Racing Fuel Cap is installed there is a possibility that a small amount of gasoline leaks out of the fuel cap resulting in a risk of fire.
remedy: On the motorcycles fitted with the affected GYTR racing fuel cap the parts will be reworked using a modification kit

concern: Natural gas system leak test
defect: On Crafter “Grand California” vehicles of a limited production period there is a possibility that the leak test of the natural gas system was not correctly carried out. Leaks from the natural gas system cannot be ruled out.
remedy: On all affected vehicles a leak test of the natural gas system must be performed and if unsuccessful necessary repairs completed. After the repair the leak test of the natural gas system must be carried out again.

concern: Fiat 600 Steering gear pinion safety recall
defect: On affected vehicles the steering rack fitted may not conform to specification and result in an increased force to rotate the steering wheel.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the steering rack will be replaced

concern: RA-03-1973 – Oil Cooler Hoses
defect: On affected vehicles the oil hoses for the engine oil cooler may be prone to split with a resulting loss of oil and oil pressure.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the oil cooler hoses will be replaced

concern: High-Voltage Battery Cell Module J01 J05
defect: On affected vehicles a cell module may not have been manufactured to specification. In the worst case this may lead to a short circuit which may result in a vehicle fire.
remedy: On affected vehicles the defective cell module will be replaced. The affected vehicles must not have their batteries charged until rectified.

concern: 2024 FL Regulator Wiring
defect: The regulator output wire may rub against the crankcase which could cause a short circuit and the main fuse may fail. This would result in a loss of all electrical power including all lighting. This will affect propulsion and visibility.
remedy: Inspect wiring and either secure or repair depending on inspection outcome.

concern: The main floor wiring harness could become damaged due to contact with the second-row bench seat folding hinge assembly. This may result in a malfunction of…
defect: Some Santa Fe (MX5) vehicles may experience the main floor wiring harness becoming damaged due to contact with the second-row bench seat folding hinge assembly.
remedy: The affected vehicles will be inspected and the main wiring harness will be secured and routed as specified within the Technical Service Bulletin. In the event the main wiring harness is damaged the main floor wire harness will be replaced

concern: ID.Buzz Cargo Shelf system strength Properties
defect: On affected vehicles the cargo shelf in the luggage compartment may become loose and penetrate into the passenger compartment presenting a risk of injury.
remedy: Remove the old rack with a new one to be built by the shelf system manufacturer.

concern: Integrated Braking System
defect: On certain vehicles the Integrated Brake (IB) system may be impaired due to contamination between electrical contacts.
remedy: Vehicles that may be affected by contamination are required to have the vehicle’s software updated which can detect signal interference before it occurs. If symptoms are detected you should refrain from use of the vehicle and the affected Integrated Brake (IB) system component will be replaced.

concern: Integrated Braking System
defect: On certain vehicles the Integrated Brake (IB) system may be impaired due to contamination between electrical contacts.
remedy: Vehicles that may be affected by contamination are required to have the vehicle’s software updated which can detect signal interference before it occurs. If symptoms are detected you should refrain from use of the vehicle and the affected Integrated Brake (IB) system component will be replaced.

concern: PS2 Seat Bolts
defect: On affected vehicles it has been identified that the four bolts on the left front seat may not have been torqued correctly at the factory.
remedy: On the affected vehicles Inspection the torque of all four bolts will be carried out and if necessary adjust the torque to the correct specification.

concern: 24C24 - Transit Custom - Side window automatic reversal system / Compliance recall
defect: On affected vehicles there is potentially an issue with the window automatic reversal system (bounce back system). Under certain circumstances a closing window could exert a force of over 100N.
remedy: Update driver and passenger door modules software.

concern: Integrated Brake Module
defect: On affected vehicles the Intergrated Brake System module may experience an electronic signal interference which may reduce braking power.
remedy: On affected vehicles the Intergrated Brake System Module will be replaced.

concern: Fiat Ducato 2024. Proxy update. Vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements
defect: Affected vehicles may have the urea system management menu missing from the instrument panel. This may result in warning messages not being displayed on the instrument panel cluster depending on the urea level. In this condition the vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements.
remedy: Check and if necessary install modified software.

concern: 2023-2024 RAM 1500 Pickup steering column control module (SCCM) internal failure
defect: Affected vehicles may have a Steering Column Control Module (SCCM) that may have been built with an insufficient weld between an internal flexible flat cable (FFC) and busbar. This may prevent deployment of the driver airbag resulting in increased risk of injury to the driver in a crash.
remedy: Inspect and if necessary replace the Steering Column Control Module.

concern: 2023 Jeep Wrangler steering column control module (SCCM) internal failure
defect: Affected vehicles may have a Steering Column Control Module (SCCM) that may have been built with an insufficient weld between an internal flexible flat cable (FFC) and busbar. This may prevent deployment of the driver airbag resulting in increased risk of injury to the driver in a crash
remedy: Inspect and if necessary replace the Steering Column Control Module.

concern: 2023 Jeep Grand Cherokee steering column control module (SCCM) internal failure
defect: Affected vehicles may have a Steering Column Control Module (SCCM) that may have been built with an insufficient weld between an internal flexible flat cable (FFC) and busbar. This may prevent deployment of the driver airbag resulting in increased risk of injury to the driver in a crash
remedy: Inspect and if necessary replace the Steering Column Control Module.

concern: Fiat Scudo Rear suspension springs
defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
remedy: Replace both rear springs.

concern: 24S57 Transit Rear hub bearing
defect: Affected vehicles may experience a lack of lubrication to the rear wheel bearings leading to premature failure.
remedy: Check of vehicles current mileage and where necessary inspect bearing to ensure full lubrication with parts replaced as necessary.

concern: Track rod ball joint and wishbone bolted connection
defect: On certain vehicles there is a possibility that on one side of the front axle the bolted connection of the track rod ball joint and the wishbone were incorrectly carried out.
remedy: The bolted connection of the track rod ball joint on the wheel bearing housing and the wishbone on the swivel joint will be checked and if necessary the nuts are replaced.

concern: A potential safety defect has been identified which could occur within the ABS control unit. The ABS control unit within the affected VIN range could…
defect: On affected vehicles the HECU (Hydraulic Electronic Control Unit) for the ABS could experience an electrical short circuit with a potential that the malfunction indicator light may become illuminated (MIL and /or ABS light) and a burning smell may emanate from the engine compartment and the HECU…
remedy: The affected vehicles will have a low-capacity fuse installed within the engine compartment junction box

concern: Clutch Dragging
defect: On affected vehicles clutch dragging may occur which could cause the vehicle to creep forward even when the clutch lever is fully depressed.
remedy: Affected vehicles will have the clutch and engine oil replaced.

concern: Replacing brake servo
defect: On certain Audi e-tron vehicles the bolted connection between the brake pedal and brake servo might not be properly secured. If it loosens the mechanical link between the foot brake and brake servo could fail. In such cases braking would only be possible using the controlled emergency braking…
remedy: For safety reasons the brake servo must be replaced on the affected vehicles.

concern: Brake line bolted connection
defect: On Caddy vehicles of a limited production period a fault when tightening the rear left brake line can cause leaks from the brake hose connection. A leak can lead to a gradual loss of brake fluid. The resulting too low brake fluid level is shown with the illumination of a warning lamp or display in…
remedy: The affected rear left brake line bolted connection at the connection to the brake hose must be checked and modified.

concern: Programming Control Units (SME)
defect: For certain vehicles there is a software update available to improve the management of the high voltage battery in the event of an insulation fault.
remedy: The battery management control software will be updated.

concern: Replace labels
defect: On affected vehicles the Type Plate may contain incorrectly printed information or has information missing.
remedy: On affected vehicles the Type Plate will be replaced.

concern: Reworking Vario Top case latch
defect: On motorcycles fitted with the accessory Vario top cases it is possible the case is not securely locked to the motorcycle and may detach.
remedy: On the affected Vario top cases the latch mechanism will be reworked and the customer operating instructions updated.

concern: 295/30ZR22 (103Y) and 315/30ZR22 (107Y) GOODYEAR EAGLE F1 SUPERSPORT
defect: A small number of 295/30ZR22 (103Y) and 315/30ZR22 (107Y) tyres are subject to a manufacturing variation and are susceptible to experiencing tread deformation or crown separation when running at high speed possibly leading to a loss of control of the vehicle.
remedy: All the dealers who may have received tyres in scope will be contacted. If they have already sold tyres we ask them to contact their customers to whom they have sold tyres. All the tyres with DOT code 1L1K8 JB1R 1224 and 1L1HA JC1R 1224 will be exchanged free of charge.

concern: Engine fuel pipe check/replace
defect: On affected vehicles there is risk that a fuel hose may chafe against a wiring harness resulting in fuel leakage onto the engine which might cause smell of fuel inside the cabin excessive fuel consumption and a risk of a thermal event in the engine compartment.
remedy: Check fuel hose and replace if necessary and install a retainer.

concern: Kia EV9 and Niro SG2 Gear Drive Unit Recall
defect: On affected vehicles due to Improper torque applied to the Gear Drive Unit during assembly by the differential gear supplier they may exhibit a grinding noise while driving which can result in a loss of motive power and/or cause the differential to lock up.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the Gear Drive Unit will be replaced.

concern: 24S29 - Transit Connect Panoramic Roof
defect: Transit Connect vehicles fitted with glass panoramic roofs may be subject to wind noise water leak and in rare cases separation from the vehicle.
remedy: Remove and re-install glass roof.

concern: Seat Belt Buckle Bracket Improper Weld
defect: On affected vehicles the passenger seat belt mount for the buckle may not be properly welded. This could result in the anchor point separating from the frame.
remedy: Affected vehicles will be checked and if required a new seat belt crossbar will be fitted.

concern: FUEL PUMP FLANGE OUTLET LEAK
defect: Affected 2023-2024 model year Polaris Sportsman 850 XP 1000 and XP 1000 S ATVs may experience a fuel leak at the fuel pump flange outlet.
remedy: Replacement of the fuel pump and a PFA cover and jumper harness will be installed.

concern: LiveWire S2 Del Mar High Voltage Fuse Recall
defect: On affected machines the high voltage fuse on the MY24 LiveWire S2 Del Mar electric motorcycle may open under certain riding conditions resulting in a loss of propulsion.
remedy: Installation of a higher voltage fuse.

concern: Handpole Casting failure
defect: On affected vehicles the hand pole fixing bracket/casting at the celling may fracture and break free resulting in the potential risk of passenger fall and injury when using the hand pole.
remedy: Remedy is to replace the current hand pole casting with the previous design casting which can handle more force.

concern: Kia Picanto EGR Valve
defect: On affected vehicles a short circuit inside the EGR (Exhaust Gas Circulation) valve may occur potentially causing the engine to stall before a warning light is displayed.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the EGR Valve will be replaced.

concern: 2024 Jeep Renegade and Compass PHEV 12V cable connection
defect: On certain vehicles the under-seat intermediate connection or the rear connection to the Integrated Dual Charging Module (IDCM) may not be tightened to the proper torque which may cause overheating of the terminal with risk of thermal incident to surrounding parts.
remedy: Check the conformity of the fastener torque on the 12V cable connection and if required replacement of the cable.

concern: Jeep Wrangler 2016 (JK) Airbag clockspring
defect: On certain vehicles the steering wheel airbag clock spring may have been built with a design that can allow dust or dirt to enter the mechanism when exposed to certain environmental conditions.
remedy: Replacement of the steering wheel airbag clock spring.

concern: Starter Motor Cable
defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk that heat from the exhaust Turbo may cause the rubber protection cap covering the power feed cable terminal to the starter motor solenoid to heat up and ignite with a risk of fire.
remedy: Remove the rubber protection cap and if necessary replace the heat shield.

concern: Anti Roll Bar C Clamp Crack
defect: On affected vehicles the C Clamp supporting the anti-roll bar may deform and shear at the upper mounting face resulting in increased body roll.
remedy: Replace Anti-roll bar C clamps with redesigned clamp.

concern: Jaguar E-PACE Inappropriate Passenger Airbag Deployment
defect: On affected vehicles during a passenger airbag deployment the airbag may tear as a result of the facia airbag deployment door panel not being sufficiently weakened.
remedy: Vehicles will have the passenger airbag module and associated components replaced.

concern: TGL TGM TGS TGX: The 24V sockets in the instrument panel can overheat.
defect: On affected vehicles an incorrect build-up of heat in the 24-volt socket installed in the instrument panel may be produced. This may result in functional impairments and damage due to heat development resulting in a fire.
remedy: Check and replace the 24-volt socket.

concern: SRPC2410 – Bolting Connection Pre-Fuse Box
defect: On affected vehicles the bolting of an electrical wire on the pre-fuse box in the passenger-side footwell might have not been tightened with sufficient torque.
remedy: Check the bolting connection of the wiring harness to the pre-fuse box and repair if necessary.

concern: Ariya (FE0) Traction Motor
defect: On affected vehicles an oil seal within the traction motor may leak causing a malfunction resulting in the traction motor going into failsafe and traction torque reducing to zero.
remedy: Replace the traction motor.

concern: Heavyweight Shock Pushrod
defect: On affected machines the rear suspension pushrod may buckle under load.
remedy: Replacement of the rear suspension pushrod.

concern: KA1 Starter Relay
defect: On affected vehicles it cannot be excluded that the improved starter relay has been mechanically damaged during installation.
remedy: On affected vehicles the starter relay will be replaced.

concern: SRPC2413 - Screw connections of 12 V and 48 V ground points
defect: On affected vehicles the bolts of certain 12V and 48V ground connections might be fastened with an insufficient torque.
remedy: Check connections and repair if necessary.

concern: Engine Starter Motor / DME Software Update
defect: On affected vehicles the starter motor may be overloaded due to repeated lengthy attempts to start the engine as the software based overload protection is not sufficient.
remedy: On affected vehicles improved software will be installed on the DME (engine starter motor electronics control unit)

concern: Replace spring U-bolts of rear axle springs
defect: On affected vehicles the spring U-bolts may not have been subject to treatment to increase their hardness which may lead to them fracturing.
remedy: Replace the spring U-bolts on the affected vehicles.

concern: Replacing TAKATA driver airbag
defect: On imported Audi vehicles previously used in a warm climate zone and fitted with TAKATA driver airbag manufactured within a specific period it is possible that the gas generator housing may cause small metal parts to become dislodged from the housing and potentially injure the driver or a passenger.
remedy: As a precautionary safety measure it is necessary to replace the gas generator in the airbag unit on the driver side of the vehicle.

concern: Seat Base and Battery Contact
defect: On affected vehicles the red battery terminal cover can be damaged if the seat is not correctly mounted. A damaged or an improperly seated battery terminal cover may result in an exposed positive (+) battery post.
remedy: Verify the condition and if necessary replace the red terminal cover.

concern: Camera Replacement on Multiple Models
defect: Due to insufficient laser welding of the camera case at the supplier during a specific production period there is a possibility that the camera case may separate when exposed to external stress over time allowing water to leak into the camera. If this occurs the circuit inside the camera can short…
remedy: Inspect camera and replace if necessary.

concern: Camera Replacement on Multiple Models
defect: Due to insufficient laser welding of the camera case at the supplier during a specific production period there is a possibility that the camera case may separate when exposed to external stress over time allowing water to leak into the camera. If this occurs the circuit inside the camera can short…
remedy: Inspect camera and replace if necessary

concern: Kia Stinger Oil Feed Pipe Leak
defect: On affected vehicles due to exposure to radiant heat from the exhaust manifold the turbocharger oil feed pipe and hose assembly may deteriorate over time this could cause an oil leak.
remedy: On affected vehicles the turbocharger oil feed pipe and hose assembly will be replaced.

concern: EM40 & EM55 Control panel connector failing
defect: On affected vehicles the EM40 and EM55 vehicle battery ‘in’ (VB IN) connector can overheat and in certain circumstances fail losing all power to the unit with the possible loss of all rear road lights.
remedy: Keepers of affected vehicles should contact their supplying dealer or any NCC approved workshop for the replacement of the affected unit. Until rectification has been completed the manufacturer advise the refrigerator is turned ‘off’ whilst driving.

concern: VARIO SIDE CASE – CUSTOMER NOTIFICATION FOR CONTINUED USAGE
defect: On motorcycles fitted with the accessory Vario side cases it is possible the locking catches for the lid do not engage and the lid is not securely locked. In this circumstance the lid may come open during use.
remedy: On the affected motorcycles additional safety measures and a warning label will be fitted to allow continued use and once available the affected boxes will be replaced.

concern: Citroen Dispatch (K0) Rear Springs
defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
remedy: Replace both rear springs.

concern: Peugeot Expert (K0) Rear Springs
defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
remedy: Replace both rear springs.

concern: Vauxhall Vivaro (K0) Rear Springs
defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
remedy: Replace both rear springs.

concern: Revuelto Fuel Feed Line Quick Connectors
defect: On certain vehicles the hose fitted onto the quick connector of the fuel feed line may not have been assembled to manufacturing specification and may become loose while operating under pressure.
remedy: Replacement of the fuel feed lines.

concern: LSS & TSS 3.0 Forward Recognition Camera on Multiple Models
defect: Due to the programming of the forward recognition camera software there is a possibility that the memory inside the forward recognition camera could fail during processing when the ignition is turned OFF. If this occurs the PCS will not activate on the next ignition start causing warning lights to…
remedy: Reprogram the Forward Recognition Camera

concern: LSS & TSS 3.0 Forward Recognition Camera on Multiple Models
defect: Due to the programming of the forward recognition camera software there is a possibility that the memory inside the forward recognition camera could fail during processing when the ignition is turned OFF. If this occurs the PCS will not activate on the next ignition start causing warning lights to…
remedy: Reprogram the Forward Recognition Camera.

concern: ARB2 - Replacing upper trailing arm on the front axle
defect: On affected vehicles there’s a possibility the upper trailing arms on the nearside front axle do not meet required specifications. If this is the case the trailing arm may break.
remedy: Replace the nearside upper trailing arm on the front axle.

concern: Transmission Control Module (TCM) software concern
defect: On affected vehicles a fault relating to the software that controls the engine / electric motor clutch may prevent the clutch from re-engaging after braking is carried out.
remedy: Update the Transmission Control Module with revised software.

concern: SRPC2341 - Housing of the rear axle transmission
defect: On affected vehicles the housing of the rear axle transmission might not meet the strength requirements.
remedy: Replace axle centrepiece of rear axle.

concern: Risk of Product becoming detached from trailer
defect: On certain trailers the welds are breaking allowing the unit to move resulting in the inserts being pulled freeing the unit from its mountings. Or the inserts are pulling out loosening the remaining fasteners and freeing the unit from its mountings.
remedy: Inspect and if necessary modify the trailer's fittings and fixtures.

concern: Risk of Product becoming detached from trailer
defect: On certain trailers the welds are breaking allowing the unit to move resulting in the inserts being pulled freeing the unit from its mountings. Or the inserts are pulling out loosening the remaining fasteners and freeing the unit from its mountings.
remedy: Inspect and if necessary modify the trailer's fittings and fixtures.

concern: Checking the Seat Mechanism of the Left Front Seat U11
defect: On affected vehicles the seat mechanism of the front left seat may not have been manufactured within accordance to specifications It is possible that an incorrectly sized rivet was used during production. As a result the mechanism may fail in the event of an accident.
remedy: On affected vehicles the front left seat mechanism will be checked and if necessary replaced.

concern: ARB3 – Checking position of rear three-point seat belt and reworking if necessary
defect: On affected vehicles it is possible that the three-point belts of the rear seat belt system were not fitted according to the specifications. If this is the case the restraint function for passengers in the rear left and right seats is not guaranteed in the event of full braking or an accident.
remedy: Check routing of the belt straps of the rear three-point belts and correct routing depending on the check result.

concern: Possible abrasion wear of the fuel supply pipe
defect: On affected vehicles there is a possibility of abrasive wear of the fuel supply line. This can cause one or several possible effects: Fuel odour in the passenger compartment High fuel consumption Fuel leak in the engine compartment visible under the vehicle Risk of fire.
remedy: Check the fuel pipe and replace if required. All affected vehicles will be fitted with a mounting clip to protect the fuel pipe.

concern: DL800DE Genuine Rear Tyre Recall
defect: On affected motorcycles the rear tyre can develop cracking or other deformation of the tyre tread under higher-speed operation conditions. In the worst case under continued use portions of the tyre tread may separate from the tyre structure and impact overall motorcycle dynamics.
remedy: Replace the rear tyre

concern: Peugeot 208- Evaporation test results on EB2FA engines.
defect: Affected vehicles may exceed regulatory emission standards.
remedy: Replace the canister purge valve (CPV) and or fuel line.

concern: Vauxhall Corsa F- Evaporation test results on EB2FA engines.
defect: Affected vehicles may exceed regulatory emission standards
remedy: Replace the canister purge valve (CPV) and or fuel line.

concern: ECM and DCU Software update
defect: Affected vehicles fitted with 1.9 RZ4E engines may under very specific driving conditions experience engine management control that may result in temporary emission irregularities.
remedy: On the affected vehicles an update to the Engine Management Control unit software will be carried out

concern: Ranger Idler Gear Failure
defect: A small number of Ranger vehicles that have been manufactured with an incorrectly assembled engine idler gear. An improperly installed engine idler gear may cause an engine stall with sudden loss of power whilst driving increasing the risk of crash or injury. A noise is typically observed from the…
remedy: Replace Idler assembly

concern: The rear inner driveshaft may develop noise resulting in a loss of drive
defect: On affected vehicles the rear inner driveshaft may develop noise resulting in a loss of drive.
remedy: On all affected vehicles replace the affected driveshaft and check properly fastened

concern: The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become defective and stop charging the 12-volt battery which can result in the vehicle entering into a…
defect: On affected vehicles the Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may be come defective and stop charging the 12volt battery this can result in the vehicle entering a failsafe driving mode
remedy: On all affected vehicles update the ICCU software and check and replace if necessary the ICCU and fuse.

concern: Replacing front suspension link
defect: A suspension link on the front axle that has invisible cracks may have been fitted to your vehicle. This possible damage means the service life of the suspension link can no longer be guaranteed and the component may fail. A failure particularly at higher speeds may result in vehicle behaviour…
remedy: For safety reasons it is necessary to replace the front upper left suspension link

concern: 2024 Model Year Range Rover and Range Rover Sport Loss of Drive
defect: For affected vehicles the clutch plates within the hybrid transmission may have been manufactured with a flatness out of tolerance to the engineering specification.
remedy: Diagnostic test to determine whether the clutch packs within the transmission are operating as expected. Any transmissions which fail the test will be replaced.

concern: 24C21 – Focus Passenger Beltminder Chime
defect: While monitoring vehicles in operation we have identified a number of Focus vehicles where the passenger belt minder chime is not activated when the vehicle goes over 15 mph. Regulatory requirements mandate that an audible chime must activate when the first-row passenger seatbelt is unfastened and…
remedy: Update the instrument panel cluster IPC configuration.

concern: Drivers side front airbag
defect: On affected vehicles a deterioration of the driver airbag propellant could occur. In the event of an accident and the activation of the driver airbag fragments of the generator housing could become detached and injure the vehicle occupants.
remedy: The driver side front airbag gas generator must be replaced in all affected vehicles.

concern: SRPC2411 – Parameter Data Set of Airbag Control Unit
defect: On affected vehicles the airbag control unit may not correspond to specifications. In the event of an accident the active bonnet may not be triggered.
remedy: Update the airbag control unit software.

concern: Brake line botled connection
defect: On affected vehicles a fault when tightening the rear left brake line can cause leaks from the brake hose connection leading to a gradual loss of brake fluid.
remedy: Check and secure the affected connection. Replace affected parts if leaking.

concern: C0390 FAS parameter update FH FM FHE FME 4
defect: There is a risk that the warnings and deactivation when the driver is not holding the steering wheel that is mandatory according to legal requirements do not occur when using the Pilot Assist System.
remedy: Update software to the latest level.

concern: SRT 360 - Software update for Forward Recognition Camera
defect: On affected vehicles a programming issue within the forward recognition camera system could potentially result in memory failure during processing and the Pre Collision Systems (PCS) not activating on the next ignition cycle with audible chimes and visual warning lights and messages displayed on…
remedy: On affected vehicles the forward recognition camera system will be reprogrammed

concern: Q50 (V37) M30/Q70 (Y51) Propeller Shaft
defect: On affected vehicles the propeller shaft does not meet Nissans' fatigue strength standards.
remedy: Replace the propeller shaft on affected vehicles.

concern: 24C18 Puma - Instrument panel cluster (IPC) software update -- Compliance recall
defect: Puma vehicles that might have an intermittent instrument panel cluster display issue due to an incorrect software configuration. If this happens the cluster will turn black when turning the ignition on or while driving. The Ford dealer will update the Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC).
remedy: Update the instrument panel cluster (IPC) software to the latest level.

concern: Check High-Voltage Battery F56 BEV
defect: On affected vehicles the seal on the high voltage battery housing may allow moisture to penetrate the battery and allow a fault to develop resulting in a check control message being displayed in some cases the High Voltage battery could switch off even when driving.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the seal will be checked and if required replace any faulty components.

concern: Replacing the Backrest Frame of the Front Left Seat
defect: On affected vehicles the welding of the recliner adjustment on the backrest of the left front seat may not have been performed to specification potentially resulting in insufficient locking of the backrest.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the Left front seat backrest will be replaced.

concern: Takata front passenger airbag

remedy: : Replace the passenger’s airbag on affected vehicles.

concern: ARB0 - Replacing brake hose on the left and right front axle
defect: On affected vehicles brake hoses were installed on the left and right of the front axle that were designed with too small a bending radius. Over time and under certain conditions this can lead to material fatigue and a defect in the brake hose.
remedy: Replace the front axle brake hoses.

concern: DS DS7 Crossback PHEV Traction Battery
defect: On affected vehicles there is a fault in the High Voltage (HV) Battery which could potentially lead to a breakdown charging issue and/or overheating and in a worst-case scenario a High Voltage Battery or vehicle fire.
remedy: Replace the High Voltage Battery.

concern: Citroen C5 Aircross PHEV Traction Battery
defect: On affected vehicles there is a fault in the High Voltage (HV) Battery which could potentially lead to a breakdown charging issue and/or overheating and in a worst-case scenario a High Voltage Battery or vehicle fire.

concern: Peugeot 3008508 PHEV. Traction Battery
defect: On affected vehicles there is a fault in the High Voltage (HV) Battery which could potentially lead to a breakdown charging issue and/or overheating and in a worst-case scenario a High Voltage Battery or vehicle fire.

concern: Vauxhall Grandland PHEV Traction Battery

concern: SRL240626 HV-BA-UESP Check high voltage batteries

concern: 24S33 – Kuga 2.5L PHEV supercreep

remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) software

concern: Front upper control arm to steering knuckle pinch bolts
defect: On affected vehicles the Upper Control Arm (UCA) pinch bolts may have been damaged during vehicle assembly. A damaged pinch bolt may break and result in the loss of clamp load between the UCA ball joint and the knuckle.
remedy: Replacement of the Upper Control Arm (UCA) pinch bolts.

concern: High pressure fuel pump
defect: On affected vehicles the high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) may fail prematurely.
remedy: Replacement of the high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) and inspection. If required replacement of additional fuel system components.

concern: EGIMOTORS ATV EXHAUST PIPE SPLIT
defect: On affected vehicles a crack can develop at the exhaust header resulting in an exhaust leak near combustible material posing a fire hazard.
remedy: A revised exhaust head pipe will be fitted to affected vehicles.

defect: The manufacturer advises DO NOT DRIVE . Affected vehicles may have a pressurised hydraulic hose fitted at the rear of the vehicle which has been compromised resulting in hydraulic fluid leakage. In rare circumstances a fire could occur.

concern: SRPC2408 - Memory Overflow Battery Management System
defect: On affected vehicles the software of the battery management system might lead to a shutdown of the high voltage system in specific situations resulting in an unannounced loss of propulsion.
remedy: Update the battery management system software.

concern: SRC240517 RC2405 Replacement of electrical switch for reverse gear

concern: AJ21-D4 Turbo Oil Feed Pipe Leak

remedy: Replace the Turbocharger oil feed pipe O-rings and install an additional clamp.

concern: C0367 HPCU SW UPDATE FHE FME4
defect: There is a risk that some screw joints inside the traction voltage batteries might not have been tightened according to our assembly process.
remedy: Update a software that can detect potential loose screw joints. It will then disconnect the suspect battery and prevent any incident.

concern: Longitudinal Chassis Beam
defect: On affected vehicles during production excessive force may have been applied to the rear left hand side chassis longitudinal beam which could lead to it cracking and affecting its structural strength.
remedy: On affected vehicles the rear left hand side chassis longitudinal beam will be checked and if necessary replaced.

concern: Checking brake lines
defect: On affected vehicles the bolts for the brake pressure lines may have been tightened too far. In such cases the bolted connection may fail resulting in brake fluid escaping.
remedy: Check the bolted connection and replace the brake pressure lines if required.

concern: Power cable chafing
defect: On affected vehicles power cables may chafe on the edge of an encapsulation plate due to edge protecting material might not have been correctly installed resulting in a potential risk of a short circuit and a consequential risk of a thermal event.
remedy: Check and adjust cable routing as necessary add rubber protection moulding as required.

concern: Focus Lane Centering Assist Software Update

concern: SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction) Diagnosis issues
defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with Engine Control Unit (ECU) software not fulfilling regulation requirements.
remedy: Update to the ECU software.

concern: Kia Stinger High Pressure Fuel Pump Recall

concern: Integrated Braking System

remedy: On the affected vehicles the Integrated Brake System will be replaced

remedy: Replace the navigation display / control unit and the telematics control unit.

concern: Audio Head Unit Replacement on Certain Aygo X

This could result in oil under pressure leaking and coming into contact with hot components of the engine which may result in a fire.…

concern: Ground connections

concern: High pressure fuel pump

remedy: Modify the wiring to the starter relay.

concern: SRC240409 RC2401 Replacement of information label for airbag on front passenger sun visor
