defect: There is a possibility that the flexible solar panel may become detached and fall into the path of other road users.
remedy: Check the solar panel is correctly adhered to the roof. If the solar panel has not been correctly bonded to the roof it will be removed and re-bonded.

concern: ENGINE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE UPDATE AND RESET REQUIRED TO ENSURE VEHICLE EMISSION COMPLIANCE
defect: Vehicle emission compliance may not be met.
remedy: An engine management software update & reset is required to ensure vehicle emission compliance.

concern: ENGINE CONTROL UNITS MIGHT BE FITTED WITH SEMICONDUCTOR COMPONENTS THAT DO NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: On a small number of vehicles manufactured within a specific period it is possible that the engine control units were fitted with semiconductor components which do not meet the specifications.
remedy: The engine control unit must be replaced on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE LEVEL SENSOR LINKAGE ON THE REAR AXLE MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED CORRECTLY
defect: The level sensor linkage on the rear axle might not have been installed correctly.
remedy: Check the level sensor linkage on the affected vehicles and install it correctly if necessary.

concern: THE ELECTRICAL PLUG CONNECTION OF THE HEADLIGHTS MIGHT NOT BE WATERTIGHT
defect: The electrical plug connection of the headlights might not be watertight.
remedy: Check the plug connection and headlights on the affected vehicles and replace it if necessary.

concern: THE BOLTING OF THE 48V GROUND CONNECTION OF THE ELECTRICAL REFRIGERANT COMPRESSOR MIGHT BE FASTENED WITH AN INSUFFICIENT TORQUE
defect: The bolting of the 48V ground connection of the electrical refrigerant compressor might be fastened with an insufficient torque.
remedy: Check the bolting of the ground connection on the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary.

concern: PREMATURE DEGRADATION OF THE RUBBER SEALS IN THE BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER
defect: Investigations have identified premature degradation of the rubber seal(s) in the brake master cylinder compromising brake performance and in extreme cases causing brake failure.
remedy: Replacement of the master cylinder or the master cylinder seals.

concern: THE ABS CONTROL UNIT WITHIN THE AFFECTED VIN RANGE COULD EXPERIENCE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT
defect: The ABS control unit within the affected VIN range could experience an electrical short. Hyundai have put advice in the interim letter for the registered keeper is to park the vehicle in an outdoor location allowing space around it until the recall is complete.
remedy: Replace the under-bonnet fuse box multi-fuse which controls the ABS control unit to a lower fuse amperage rating.

concern: THE PASSENGER AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS SPECIFIED
defect: The passenger airbag may not deploy as specified.
remedy: Replace the passenger airbag.

concern: THE PASSENGER AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS SPECIFIED
defect: The passenger airbag may not deploy as specified.
remedy: Replace the passenger airbag.

concern: THE BOLTING CONNECTIONS OF THE DRIVER AND PASSENGER SEAT RAIL AND BODY SHELL MIGHT NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS
defect: The bolting connections of the driver and passenger seat rail and the body shell might not meet the requirements.
remedy: Rework the bolt connection between the seat rail and the body shell.

concern: THE AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM EVAPORATOR HOUSING DRAINPIPE MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED
defect: The drainpipe of the evaporator housing of the air conditioning system may have been incorrectly manufactured leading to water accumulating and dripping onto the airbag control unit.
remedy: Check the drainpipe of the evaporator housing. If found to be incorrectly manufactured the drainpipe must be modified and the airbag control unit replaced.

concern: SHIFTER CONTROL UNIT (SCU) UPGRADE.
defect: A voltage fluctuation may occur when the vehicle is switched off and in the parked position resulting in a temporary disengagement of the parking mechanism.
remedy: The vehicles identified require a software update for the Shifter Control Unit (SCU).

concern: SPORADIC MALFUNCTIONS IN A PRESSURE CASTING SYSTEM CAUSED INDIVIDUAL REAR WHEEL BEARING HOUSINGS TO BE FITTED WITH OXIDE INCLUSIONS
defect: On Tiguan LWB vehicles of a limited production period sporadic malfunctions in a pressure casting system caused individual rear wheel bearing housings to be fitted with oxide inclusions.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the production date of the two rear wheel bearing housings is checked and if necessary replaced.

concern: VEHICLES FITTED WITH TAKATA DRIVER AIRBAGS EQUIPPED WHICH MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED WHEN DEPLOYED
defect: Vehicles fitted withTakata driver airbags equipped which may not function as intended when deployed.
remedy: Replace the affected driver airbags on the affected vehicles

concern: SOME VEHICLES DO NOT HAVE AN AUDIBLE WARNING WHEN THE REAR FOG LAMP IS LEFT SWITCHED ON
defect: The audible warning when the rear fog lamp is left switched on the ignition is switched off and the driver�s door opened on some vehicles does not function.
remedy: Update the dash cluster software to include an audible warning function.

concern: THE FRONT SPROCKET MAY BE DEFECTIVE AND MAY BE SUBJECT TO PREMATURE WEAR
defect: The front sprocket may be defective and may be subject to premature wear.
remedy: The front sprocket will need to be replaced.

concern: CERTAIN MODE 2 CHARGING CABLES FOR CHARGING AT A HIOUSEHOLD POWER SOCKET MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: Certain Mode 2 charging cables for charging at a household power socket might not meet specifications.
remedy: Check the Mode 2 charging cable on the affected vehicles and replace it if necessary.

concern: A FUEL LEAK CAN DEVELOP ON THE DIESEL LOW PRESSURE FUEL LINE
defect: It has been found that a fuel leak can develop on the diesel low pressure fuel line which is mounted to the engine.
remedy: Replace the low pressure fuel line module with improved parts.

concern: THE FUNCTION OF THE BRAKE BOOSTER MIGHT BE AFFECTED DUE TO ADVANCED CORROSION IN THE JOINT AREA OF ITS HOUSING
defect: The function of the brake booster might be affected due to advanced corrosion in the joint area of its housing.
remedy: Check the brake booster on the affected vehicles and - depending on the result of this inspection - replace it where necessary.

concern: THE FUNCTION OF THE BRAKE BOOSTER MIGHT BE AFFECTED DUE TO ADVANCED CORROSION IN THE JOINT AREA OF ITS HOUSING
defect: The function of the brake booster might be affected due to advanced corrosion in the joint area of its housing.
remedy: Check the brake booster on the affected vehicles and - depending on the result of this inspection - replace it where necessary.

concern: THE BOLTING OF THE 48V GROUND CONNECTION UNDER THE PASSENGER SEAT MIGHT BE FASTENED WITH AN INSUFFICIENT TORQUE
defect: The bolting of the 48V ground connection under the passenger seat might be fastened with an insufficient torque.
remedy: Check the bolting of the ground connection on the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary.

concern: POTENTIAL DAMAGE TO THE TYRE STRUCTURE AROUND THE TYRE BEAD
defect: Tyres may have been damaged in the manufacturing plant.
remedy: Visually check the affected tyres and replace them if necessary.

concern: THE INSTRUMENT PANEL CLUSTER LIQUID-CRYSTAL DISPLAY PANEL IN THE SUBJECT VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH INCORRECT SPECIFICATION RESISTORS
defect: The instrument panel cluster liquid-crystal display panel in the subject vehicles may have been manufactured with incorrect specification resistors.
remedy: Replace the instrument cluster assembly.

concern: IF A FAILURE IS DETECTED BY THE CONTROL UNIT THE AIR BAG WARNING LIGHT AND CHECK CONTROL MESSAGE WOULD NOT BE ILLUMINATED AND ACTIVATED
defect: If a failure is detected by the control unit the airbag warning light and check control message would not to be illuminated and activated.
remedy: The Airbag control unit (ACSM6) will be reprogrammed with new software.

concern: ONE OR BOTH HEADRESTS OF THE FIRST ROW 2-PERSON BENCH SEAT CANNOT BE LOCKED INTO PLACE
defect: There is a possibility that one or both headrests of the first row 2-person bench seat cannot be locked into place.
remedy: Inspect and replace the headrest(s) if necessary.

concern: INDIVIDUAL BOLTS OR CHAIN LINKS OF THE CAMSHAFT TIMING CHAIN MIGHT WEAR
defect: Individual bolts or chain links of the camshaft timing chain might wear in case of a long term operation under specific driving conditions.
remedy: Replace the camshaft timing chain on the affected vehicles

concern: THE WIND SCREEN WIPER MIGHT STOP WORKING ON THE TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH RAIN SENSOR
defect: There is a risk that the wind screen wiper might stop working.
remedy: Update vehicle software and replace the wiper relay.

concern: THE VEHICLES MAY HAVE THE WRONG VIN PRINTED ON THE B PILLAR VIN STICKER
defect: The vehicles may have the wrong VIN printed on the �B pillar� VIN sticker.
remedy: Check and if necessary replace the �B pillar� VIN sticker.

concern: A FAULT HAS BEEN IDENTIFIED IN THE MANUFACTURE OF THE FRONT L/H SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONER
defect: A fault has been identified in the manufacture of the front L/H seatbelt pre-tensioner.
remedy: Replace the front L/H seatbelt pre-tensioner.

concern: THE FRONT CRASH SENSOR FIXINGS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED TO THE SPECIFIED TORQUE
defect: The front crash sensor fixings may not have been installed to the specified level of torque.
remedy: Check and tighten the front crash sensor fixing to the specified level of torque.

concern: A DEFECTIVE SCALE AT THE SUPPLIER DELIVERED WRONG OIL WEIGHT DATA FOR OIL FILLING FOR A CERTAIN NUMBER OF TRANSMISSIONS
defect: A defective scale at the supplier delivered wrong oil weight data for oil filling for a certain number of transmissions.
remedy: The oil level within the gearbox will be checked and corrected.

concern: THE PASSENGER SEATBELT WARNING CHIME MIGHT BE INOPERATIVE
defect: The passenger seatbelt warning chime might be inoperative.
remedy: Reprogram the Body Control Module software.

concern: SUPPLY CABLES FOR THE 48 VOLT BATTERY SYSTEM HAVE AN INCORRECT TIGHTENING TORQUE
defect: Supply cables for the 48Volt battery system have an incorrect tightening torque.
remedy: Inspect and retighten cable fixing screws for the 48Volt battery system.

concern: THE STEERING OF CERTAIN EQE (295 PLATFORM) VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING THE ASSEMBLY PROCESS
defect: The steering of certain EQE (295 platform) vehicles may have been damaged during the assembly process.
remedy: Replace the steering on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE SELECTIVE CATALYTIC REDUCTION SYSTEM DOES NOT HEAT UP AS REQUIRED
defect: Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) system does not heat up as required.
remedy: Replace the affected Urea Reservoir.

concern: THE SOFTWARE OF THE REAR SIGNAL ACQUISITION AND ACTUATION MODULE MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The software of the rear signal acquisition and actuation module might not meet specifications.
remedy: Update the software of the signal acquisition and actuation module on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE HANDS-OFF DETECTION MIGHT NOT DETECT WHEN THE DRIVER'S HANDS ARE AWAY FROM THE STEERING WHEEL
defect: The hands-off detection might not detect when the driver's hands are away from the steering wheel.
remedy: Update the coding of the hand detection system on the affected vehicles.

concern: ONE OR MORE CONTROL UNIT VEHICLE CONFIGURATIONS MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: Vehicles configurations were written into one or more control units that might not meet specifications.
remedy: Update the configuration of the affected control units on the vehicles.

concern: THE SOFTWARE OF THE HEADLAMPS MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS.
defect: The software of the headlamps might not meet specifications.
remedy: Replace the affected headlamp control units on the vehicles.

concern: THE RIVET USED TO RETAIN THE CURTAIN AIR BAG COULD BE INCORRECTLY FITTED
defect: The rivet used to retain the curtain airbag in some vehicles could be incorrectly fitted.
remedy: Check if the curtain airbag is correctly retained by the rivet and if necessary refit the curtain airbag correctly.

concern: THE SECOND ROW SEATS MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY ALIGNED AND LOCKED ON ALL SEAT RAILS
defect: The 2nd row seats may not be correctly aligned and locked on all seat rails.
remedy: Check and re-set the relative 2nd row seat rail positions to ensure proper engagement of the seat rail runners.

concern: THE COOLANT PUMP MIGHT HAVE A LEAKAGE BETWEEN THE VACUUM SYSTEM AND THE COOLANT CIRCUIT
defect: On certain vehicles with an OM654 engine the coolant pump which is controlled by vacuum might have a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.
remedy: Update the software of the coolant pump and replace the electrical switch valve on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE FABRIC PROTECTIVE HOSE OF THE WIRING HARNESS OF THE FRONT SEATS CAN BE DAMAGED WHEN ADJUSTING THE SEAT IN THE LONGITUDINAL DIRECTION
defect: There is a possibility that the fabric protective hose of the wiring harness of the front seats can be damaged when adjusting the seat in the longitudinal direction and subsequently be pulled into the drive spindle of the seat adjustment.
remedy: On affected vehicles check the wiring harness of the front seats rework with textile tape and repair if necessary.

concern: HEADRESTS ON THE FRONT MODULAR SEAT DO NOT CONFORM TO THE DESIGN SPECIFICATION
defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with headrests on the front modular seat which do not conform to the design specification.
remedy: Check the conformity of the front headrests (presence of the catch); in cases of non-conformity the front headrests will be replaced.

concern: HEADRESTS ON THE FRONT MODULAR SEAT DO NOT CONFORM TO THE DESIGN SPECIFICATION
defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with headrests on the front modular seat which do not conform to the design specification.
remedy: Check the conformity of the front headrests (presence of the catch); in cases of non-conformity the front headrests will be replaced.

concern: CRACKS CAN OCCUR ON THE REAR SPOILER CARRIERS AND RADIATOR FLAPS
defect: Due to a weak supporting structure for the roof attachments cracks can occur on the rear spoiler carriers and the radiator flaps.
remedy: The components of the supporting structure for the rear spoiler carrier and radiator flap will be replaced by a reinforced version.

concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system on the affected vehicles.

concern: CERTAIN SPOT WELDS MIGHT BE MISSING.
defect: With body panels that are spot-welded to the left and right front shock absorber mounting areas there is a possibility that certain spot-welds were missed.
remedy: Inspect the welding near the shock absorber mounting area. If any missing spot-weld is found welds will be added and damage to the vehicle if any will be repaired.

concern: THE MESH SIZE OF THE OIL STRAINER IN THE OIL SUPPLY FOR BOTH TURBOCHARGERS IS TOO SMALL
defect: The mesh size of the oil strainer in the oil supply for both turbochargers is too small.
remedy: The oil strainer will be replaced with a revised version with a larger mesh size.

concern: THE ELECTRICAL CONNECTOR TO THE PTC HEATER CAN OVERHEAT
defect: The PTC (positive temperature coefficient) heater in some Sorento diesel models can overheat due to damaged connector terminal.
remedy: Inspect and if the PTC connector is found damaged replace the PTC and relevant wiring connector. Upgrade the operating logic of the PTC

concern: A COMPONENT ON THE ELECTRONIC CIRCUIT BOARD OF THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT COULD BE DAMAGED OR DISPLACED
defect: On certain vehicles with the highline version of the airbag control unit a component on the electronic circuit board of the airbag control unit could be damaged or displaced.
remedy: Replace the airbag control unit on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN BOLTED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The airbag control unit might not have been bolted according to specifications.
remedy: Check the bolting of the airbag control unit on the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary.

concern: SOME ENGINE AND BODY GROUND CONNECTIONS MAY NOT BE SECURED TO SPECIFICATION
defect: Some Engine and Body ground connections may not be secured to specification.
remedy: Check the ground connections and if necessary tighten them according to specifications.

concern: CERTIFICATE OF CONFORMITY CONTAINS INCORRECT CO2 AND FUEL ECONOMY VALUES
defect: The Certificate of Conformity (COC) paper contains the incorrect information.
remedy: Request customer to return old COC paper and issue new corrected COC paper.

concern: CRANKSHAFT MIGHT NOT MEET REQUIRED SPECIFICATION
defect: On certain vehicles with an OM654 classic diesel engine the crankshaft might not correspond with the required specification
remedy: As a precautionary measure the engines will be replaced on the affected vehicles

concern: REAR SUSPENSION PIVOT STRUTS ARE NOT TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION OR REQUIRED STABILITY
defect: During installation pivot struts that did not correspond to the specification and that did not have the required stability were installed on the rear suspension strut.
remedy: Replace the relay lever.

concern: THE OVERHEAD CONTROL PANEL MIGHT BE DEACTIVATED PERMANENTLY DUE TO A SOFTWARE ERROR
defect: The overhead control panel under certain circumstances might be deactivated permanently due to a software error.
remedy: Update the software of the overhead control panel.

concern: THE TAIL LAMP MAY START FLICKERING WHEN RECEIVING A VOLTAGE CLOSE TO THE MAXIMUM (16V)
defect: When the tail-lamp is receiving a voltage close to the maximum (16V) the tail-lamp may start flickering.
remedy: Check the production date of the tail-lamps if the fitted lamps are within the defective range replacement of the rear lamp/lamps will be required.

concern: THE REAR SPOILER MAY BE FITTED SO IT IS OVER HANGING THE ROOF.
defect: The rear spoiler may be fitted so it is overhanging the roof allowing contact with the roof when opening or closing the tailgate.
remedy: The rear spoiler will be inspected for correct installation. If needed the upper spoiler section will be replaced and the spoiler reattached to the vehicle.

concern: IN CERTAIN CONDITIONS THE USER INTERFACE (UI ) ON AFFECTED VEHICLES DISPLAYS VEHICLE SPEED BUT NOT A UNIT OF SPEED(I.E MPH OR KM/H)
defect: In certain conditions the user interface (�UI�) on affected vehicles displays vehicle speed but not a unit of speed (i.e. mph or km/h).
remedy: Tesla will deploy an over the air firmware update that will reintroduce the display of the speed unit when using Track Mode.

concern: THE ROOF SPOILER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN BONDED TO THE REAR LID WITH THE SPECIFIED PROCESS MATERIALS
defect: On all affected Polo vehicles there is a possibility that the roof spoiler may not have been bonded to the rear lid with the specified process materials.
remedy: On all affected vehicles the roof spoiler has to be replaced.

concern: ONE GROUND CABLE IS INCORRECTLY INSTALLED
defect: One ground cable is incorrectly installed which means an under dimensioned cable is incorrectly connected to the wrong grounding point.
remedy: Repair kits have been developed which include instruction on how to replace the affected cable.

concern: A LOSS OF LOW VOLTAGE SYSTEM SUPPORT MAY CAUSE THE AUDIO SUBSYSTEM TO BE UNAVAILABLE
defect: On certain vehicles that are running firmware release 2022.8 and that experience a loss of low voltage system support the audio subsystem may become unavailable including the use of eCall functionality.
remedy: Firmware release 2022.12.3 or later reverses the power management process introduced in firmware release 2022.8 and maintains eCall audio functionality.

concern: THE INITIALIZATION OF THE RADAR SENSOR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN COMPLETED CORRECTLY
defect: The initialization of the radar sensor may not have been completed correctly.
remedy: Inspect the radar sensor and if necessary properly initialize the radar sensor.

concern: THE FUEL TANK MODULE LOCKING RING HAS BECOME LOOSE
defect: It has been found on a small number of vehicles that fuel tank module locking ring has become loose.
remedy: Check for the position of the locking tabs of the locating ring and rework if not correct.

concern: THE LEVEL OF OIL IN THE GEARBOX MAY BE INSUFFICIENT
defect: The level of oil in the gearbox may be insufficient.
remedy: The gear oil level on the affected vehicles must be checked and topped up if necessary.

concern: THE COOLANT PUMP MIGHT HAVE A LEAKAGE.
defect: On certain vehicles the coolant pump which is controlled by vacuum might have a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.
remedy: Update the software of the coolant pump and replace the electrical switch valve on the affected vehicles. Additionally a check of the vacuum system for possible contamination with coolant or engine oil will be carried out as a precautionary measure for the vehicles in this recall without the…

concern: REAR BRAKE DISC BOLTS MAY LOOSEN.
defect: The rear Brake Disc bolts may loosen.
remedy: Replace the rear brake disc bolts on all the affected models.

concern: IN THE EVENT OF A FRONTAL COLLISION THE FRONT IMPACT SENSORS COULD BECOME DISCONNECTED AND THE AIR BAGS MAY NOT ACTIVATE AS EXPECTED
defect: In the event of a frontal collision the front impact sensors could become disconnected and the air bags may not activate as expected.
remedy: Update the software in the Air Bag Control (ACU) the improved collision algorithm will ensure that airbags deploy properly in the event of a collision.

concern: DAMAGE CAN OCCUR IN THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT
defect: Damage can occur within the vehicles Air Bag Control unit causing the warning light to be displayed and the Air Bag system deactivated.
remedy: Inspect the vehicles if the Air Bag warning light is already illuminated replace the control unit. If it is not update the software in the unit.

concern: The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect (4835 kg instead…
defect: The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect.
remedy: The CoC and registration documents must be replaced to reflect the correct data.

concern: THE RIGHT-HAND ENGINE OIL SEPERATOR MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED PRIOR TO ENGINE ASSEMBLY.
defect: Certain vehicles could have an engine oil separator that may have been damaged prior to engine assembly.
remedy: Inspect the engine oil separator and if found to be damaged and/or leaking a replacement engine oil separator must be installed

concern: THE STANDING ASSIST SYSTEM DOES NOT RELEASE IMMEDIATELY AFTER DE-ACTIVATION
defect: In some situations the standing assist system does not release immediately after de-activation.
remedy: Do not use the Standing Assist function until the currently in-development modification has been installed.

concern: POSSIBILITY OF LEAKAGE OF FUEL FROM THE AUXILLARY HEATER UNIT.
defect: On some vehicles equipped with a Webasto auxiliary heating unit there is the possibility of a leakage of fuel from the auxiliary heater unit.
remedy: : Modify the Webasto additional heater unit power supply routing and update the body electronic control unit software.

concern: THE ELECTRIC RESISTANCE IN THE CIRCUIT BOARD OF THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MAY BE INTERRUPTED IN THE EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT
defect: On certain vehicles with the highline version of the airbag control unit the electric resistance in the circuit board of the airbag control unit may be interrupted in the event of an accident.
remedy: Replace the airbag control unit.

concern: IN SOME VEHICLESTHE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM HAS BEEN PRODUCED IN PART WITH AN INSUFFICIENT AMOUNT OF EXTINGUISHING SAND
defect: In some vehicles the fuse in the high-voltage system has been produced in part with an insufficient amount of extinguishing sand.
remedy: An insulating mat must be placed above the switching unit for the high-voltage battery in all of the affected vehicles.

concern: THE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM OF PLUG-IN HYBRID VEHICLES WAS PARTLY PRODUCED WITH AN INSUFFICIENT AMOUNT OF SO-CALLED FIRE EXTINGUISHING SAND
defect: The fuse in the high-voltage system of plug-in hybrid vehicles was partly produced with an insufficient amount of so-called fire extinguishing sand.
remedy: An additional protective insulating mat is to be fitted over the switch box of the high-voltage battery.

concern: THE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM OF PLUG-IN HYBRID VEHICLES WAS IN SOME CASES PRODUCED WITH TOO LITTLE SO-CALLED FIRE SAND
defect: The fuse in the high-voltage system of plug-in hybrid vehicles was in some cases produced with too little so-called fire sand.
remedy: An additional protective insulating mat is to be fitted to the switching unit for high-voltage battery.

concern: THE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH AN INSUFFICIENT QUANTITY OF EXTINGUISHING SAND
defect: The fuse in the high-voltage system (HV system) in vehicles built within a limited period may have been manufactured with an insufficient quantity of extinguishing sand.
remedy: Insulation must be fitted above the switching unit for the high-voltage battery.

concern: THE FUEL TANK FEED LINE CONNECTION MAY NOT BE FITTED CORRECTLY
defect: The fuel tank feed line connection that is pre-fitted at the supplier to the fuel pump may not be fitted correctly.
remedy: The fuel tank will need to be lowered and the fuel line feed connection to be checked and refitted as necessary.

concern: VEHICLES WITH AN OM654 ENGINE MIGHT HAVE A LEAKAGE BETWEEN THE VACUUM SYSTEM AND THE COOLANT CIRCUIT
defect: On certain vehicles with a Diesel engine the coolant pump which is controlled by vacuum might have a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.�
remedy: Update the software of the coolant pump and replace the electrical switch valve on the affected vehicles.�

concern: A POSSIBLE NON-CONFORMITY OF THE ZINC PLATING SURFACE TREATMENT OF A SMALL COMPONENT OF THE BRAKE HOSE TERMINALS MAY RESULT IN AN INCREASE IN THE BRAKE LEVER…
defect: A possible non-conformity of the zinc plating surface treatment of a small component of the brake hose terminals may result in an increase in the brake lever travel.
remedy: Conduct checks of the brake lever and pedal movement and if necessary replace the brake fluid and bleed the system.

concern: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE PARKING BRAKE AIR TUBE CAN BE AFFECTED BY HEAT EXPOSURE
defect: During operation of the vehicle with high loads on the engine combined with an exhaust leakage in the engine compartment there is a risk that the parking brake air tube can be affected by heat exposure.
remedy: Retrofit a protection sleeve on the parking brake tube.

concern: THE WIRING HARNESS OF THE ALTERNATOR MAY POSSIBLY HAVE BEEN SWAPPED WITH THE WIRING HARNESS OF THE ELECTRIC STEERING
defect: The wiring harness of the alternator may have been swapped with the wiring harness of the electric steering in the assembly procedure of certain vehicles.
remedy: Check the affected lines and if necessary connect the correspondent wiring harnesses.

concern: INCORRECT FRONT PASSENGER SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES WITHOUT AN AUTOMATIC LOCKING RETRACTOR FUNCTION (ALR) MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED
defect: Incorrect front passenger seat belt assemblies without an automatic locking retractor (ALR) function may have been installed.
remedy: Inspect the affected front seat belt assemblies and replace if necessary.

concern: THE MICRO GAS GENERATOR WITHIN THE FRONT SEATBELT'S RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED
defect: The micro gas generator within the front seatbelt�s retractor may have been damaged and may not act according to the specification in the event of an accident.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the front seatbelts will be checked and replaced if they are found to have been damaged.

concern: THE MICRO GAS GENERATOR WITHIN THE FRONT SEATBELT'S RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED
defect: The micro gas generator within the front seatbelt�s retractor may have been damaged and may not act according to the specification in the event of an accident.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the front seatbelts will be checked and replaced if they are found to have been damaged

concern: THE OBD SOFTWARE COULD MISINTERPRET CERTAIN INPUT PARAMETERS FOR THE ENGINE MANGEMENT SYSTEM
defect: During a service visit the affected vehicles have been updated with software that could misinterpret certain input parameters for the engine management system.
remedy: The control units will be reprogrammed with an improved version of software.

concern: THE SOUND GENERATOR (AVAS) MAY PERMANENTLY FAIL DUE TO A SOFTWARE ERROR
defect: The sound generator (AVAS - Acoustic Vehicle Alerting System) may permanently fail due to a software error
remedy: The sound generator (AVAS) installed in the vehicle will be replaced.

concern: VEHICLES DO NOT HOLD THE NECESSARY APPROVAL CERTIFICATION
defect: Vehicles do not hold the necessary approval certification.
remedy: Vehicles will be reworked to the approval standard and be VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) marked. This will include the fitment of e-marked lights/reflectors mirrors horn side stand and a compliant speedometer.The motor and motor controller will both be altered.

concern: EXTERIOR DOOR HANDLES MIGHT STAY OPEN AND THE DOOR WILL NOT BE LOCKED
defect: Exterior door handles might stay open and the door will not be locked.
remedy: Check the four door handles and replace them if necessary.

concern: A ROTATIONAL SPEED SENSOR IN THE TRANSMISSION COULD POSSIBLY CHAFE THE ELECTRICAL LINE
defect: A rotational speed sensor in the transmission could possibly chafe the electrical line.
remedy: Replace the rotational speed sensor and optimize the electrical line installation.

concern: BOLTING ON BRAKE CALIPER HOUSING MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The bolting on the brake caliper housing might not meet torque specifications.�
remedy: Check and if necessary rework the bolting of the brake caliper housings on the affected vehicles.

concern: A PARTICLE IN THE FUEL RAIL MIGHT LEAD TO A LEAK BETWEEN THE FUEL RAIL AND THE INJECTOR

remedy: Check the guide sleeves on the rear seats of the potentially affected vehicles and replace them if necessary.

concern: POOR PERFORMANCE OF THE FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM
defect: Poor performance of the fuel injection system due to a fuel contamination (not linked with a quality of the fuel itself).
remedy: Replacement of the fuel filter cartridge increasing the filtration system and testing the injectors. In case of checks with negative result the electro-injectors will be replaced.

concern: INTERNAL SOFTWARE ERROR IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE POWER ELECTRONICS
defect: It is possible for the affected vehicles to display the warning message Drive control disturbed - Park vehicle safely in the instrument cluster.
remedy: The high-voltage power electronics must be reprogrammed with corrected software.

concern: THE BOLTING OF THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY TO THE VEHICLE BODY IN THE LUGGAGE COMPARTMENT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The bolting of the high-voltage battery to the vehicle body in the luggage compartment might not meet specifications.
remedy: Check the bolting of the high-voltage battery to the vehicle body on the affected vehicles and rework if necessary.

concern: THE PASSENGER AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT DOOR INTEGRATED IN THE INSTRUMENT PANEL FACIA CONTAINS AN ADDITIONAL MESH LAYER
defect: The passenger airbag deployment door integrated in the instrument panel facia contains an additional mesh layer.
remedy: Replace the affected instrument panel facia with a part manufactured to the correct specification.

concern: THE RETURN HOSES OF THE POWER HYDRAULICS MAY NOT WITHSTAND THE SPECIFIED SYSTEM PRESSURE DUE TO THE AGING PROCESS
defect: The return hoses of the power hydraulics may not withstand the specified system pressure due to the aging process.
remedy: Replace the return hoses of the power hydraulics.

concern: THE BOLTING OF A SIDE CRASH SENSOR MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The bolting of a side crash sensor may not meet specifications.
remedy: Check the bolting of the side crash sensor on the affected vehicles and rework it if necessary.

concern: DURING VEHICLE OPERATION THE AIR SPRING MEMBER CAN GET LOOSEAND A STEERING EFFECTMIGHT APPEAR FOR THE REAR AXLE
defect: Nuts used for the rear axle snow chain installation may have wrong material hardness.�
remedy: Replace nuts on all affected trucks

concern: SCREWS SECURING STEERING COLUMN TO STEERING GEAR DON'T MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The screws securing the steering column to the steering gear may not meet� the required specifications on�affected vehicles.�
remedy: The steering column screws must be replaced.�

concern: On affected vehicles there is a potential fault with the fuel pump module. This could result in the vehicle not starting and in rare circumstances a loss of…
defect: On affected vehicles there is a potential fault with the fuel pump module. This could result in the vehicle not starting and in rare circumstances a loss of torque or engine stalling.
remedy: Replace the fuel pump module and reprogram the injection computer.

concern: SOME VEHICLES MAY BE SUSCEPTIBLE TO DAMAGE TO THE ANTI-CORROSION COATING OF THE LOWER STEERING SHAFT
defect: Some vehicles may be susceptible to damage to the anti-corrosion coating of the lower steering shaft.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the steering shaft must be replaced.

concern: THE BRAKE PEDAL SHAFT COULD BECOME DETACHED FROM THE PEDAL CONTROLS BEARING MOUNT
defect: It is possible that the brake pedal shaft could become detached from the pedal controls bearing mount.
remedy: On affected vehicles the brake pedal bearing shaft must be secured in the pedal controls with a roll pin.

concern: FAILURE OF THE FRONT AXLE BEAM
defect: Possible failure of the front axle beam due to inadequate welds.
remedy: Weld a strengthening plate to the axle beam.

concern: THE SIDE CURTAIN AIRBAG COULD POTENTIALLY BE ASSEMBLED IN A TWISTED CONDITION
defect: The side curtain airbag could potentially be assembled in a twisted condition.
remedy: Affected vehicles will be inspected to ascertain if the airbag is correctly installed. If the airbag is twisted it will be removed and reinstalled correctly.

concern: THE ABS CONTROL UNIT PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD COULD EXPERIENCE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT UNDER SPECIFIC CONDITIONS
defect: The ABS control unit printed circuit board (PCB) could experience an electrical short under specific conditions.
remedy: The HECU (ABS/ESC) control unit fuses will be reworked.

concern: IMPROPER DESIGN OF THE DRIVER SIDE AND THE PASSENGER SIDE DOOR HARNESSES MAY AFFECT AIR BAG OPERATION
defect: Improper design of the driver side and the passenger side door harnesses may affect air bag operation..
remedy: Replace the door harnesses of the affected vehicles.

concern: THE FUEL FEEDING IMPELLER IN THE FUEL PUMP MAY BE SWOLLEN AND DEFORMED
defect: The fuel feeding impeller in the fuel pump may be swollen and deformed.
remedy: Replace fuel pump.

concern: POSSIBLE THERMAL ESCALATION IN CAB HEATER DUE TO RELAY FAILURE
defect: Possible thermal escalation in cab heater due to relay failure.
remedy: Replacement of the power relays for cooling heater.

concern: THE REAR SPRING CENTRALISER MIGHT BE WELDED INCORRECTLY
defect: The rear spring centraliser might be welded incorrectly.
remedy: Add 3 weld spots to the rear spring centralisers

concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE RECEIVED DURING A REPAIR A REMANUFACTURED STEERING RACK
defect: Vehicles may have received during a repair a remanufactured steering rack where the track rod ends have not been installed correctly.
remedy: Inspect the steering rack and repair if required

concern: THE NUTS OF THE 12V CONNECTOR MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED INCORRECTLY
defect: The nuts of the 12V connector may not be tightened correctly.
remedy: : Check the 12V earth connection and ensure correct torque is applied.

concern: THE REAR SPRING CENTRALISER MIGHT BE WELDED INCORRECTLY
defect: The rear spring centraliser might be welded incorrectly.
remedy: Add 3 weld spots to the rear spring centralisers.

concern: TEMPERATURE WARNING SYSTEM MAY NOT PROVIDE A WARNING WHEN INTENDED
defect: Temperature warning system for the third alternator may not provide a warning when intended.
remedy: Check if the temperature sensor is in correct position and adjust if required.

concern: THE RIGHT LINKAGE ADJUSTERS ON THE REAR AXLE WERE MANUFACTURED INCORRECTLY
defect: The right linkage adjusters on the rear axle were manufactured incorrectly.
remedy: Replacement of the right linkage adjusters on the rear axle.

concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system on the affected vehicles.

concern: THERE MAY BE AN INCORRECT TIGHTENING TORQUE APPLICATION ON THE REAR WHEEL HUB
defect: There may be an incorrect tightening torque application on the rear wheel hub.
remedy: Check the rear wheel bearing hub screws and if necessary replace the screws on both sides of the vehicle.

concern: THE PLUG OF THE ACTIVATED CHARCOAL CANISTER DRAINAGE HOSE CAN BE DAMAGED BY HEAT FROM THE EXHAUST SYSTEM
defect: The plug of the activated charcoal canister drainage hose can be damaged by heat from the exhaust system.
remedy: The existing plug must be replaced by the new aluminum version.

concern: FAILURE OF CONNECTING RODS
defect: Failure of connecting rods resulting in catastrophic engine failure due to supplied connecting rods manufactured outside of specification.
remedy: Replace the engine with one that contains connecting rods that meet specification

concern: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING
defect: The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring
remedy: Update EMS software.

concern: WHEN STARTING THE VEHICLE THE 'STOP & START' SYSTEM MAY NOT BE ACTIVATED THIS COULD LEAD TO AN INCREASE IN THE LEVEL OF EMISSIONS AND FUEL CONSUMPTION OF YOUR…
defect: When starting the vehicle the Stop & Start system may not be activated. This could lead to an increase in the level of emissions and fuel consumption of your vehicle.
remedy: Update the software for the Stop & Start system.

concern: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING
defect: The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring.
remedy: Update EMS software.

concern: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING
defect: The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring.
remedy: Update EMS software.

concern: THE MIDDLE FASTENING OF THE ROOF RAIL COULD COME LOOSE
defect: The middle fastening of the roof rail could come loose.
remedy: Carry out a check of the roof rail and replace if necessary.

concern: ON SOME VEHICLES WITH A REAR-VIEW CAMERA THE TAILGATE MAY BE UNLOCKED INDEPENDENTLY / AUTOMATICALLY
defect: On some vehicles with a rear-view camera the tailgate may be unlocked independently/automatically.
remedy: Seal the duct for the electrical wiring harness of reversing camera on the affected vehicles.

concern: A DEFECTIVE SHIFT DRUM MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED
defect: A defective shift drum may have been installed.
remedy: The shift drum must be replaced on all affected motorcycles.

concern: THE BOLTS AND NUTS OF THE CONTROL ARMS MIGHT BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED
defect: The bolts and nuts of both the control arms might be incorrectly tightened.
remedy: Replace the bolts and nuts of both the control arms and tighten to the correct specifications.

concern: THE INSIDE OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL PUMP MAY BE WORN OR DAMAGED OVER TIME DURING OPERATION
defect: The inside of the high-pressure fuel pump may be worn or damaged over time during operation.
remedy: Inspect* and if necessary replace the high-pressure fuel pump. (*Based on engine variant and/or pump manufacturer/pump serial number.)

concern: THE INCORRECT WEIGHT INFORMATION WAS APPLIED TO THE CERTIFICATE OF CONFORMITY
defect: The incorrect weight information was applied to the Certificate of Conformity (COC).
remedy: To proactively update the Certificate of Conformity (COC) and replace the vehicle registration document of all potentially affected vehicles.

concern: THE AIR BAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE DURING DEPLOYMENT
defect: The air bag inflator may rupture during deployment.
remedy: Replacement of the air bag inflator.

concern: REAR AXLE SUSPENSION LINKS NUTS DO NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: One or more nuts which do not meet the specifications may have been fitted on the rear axle suspension links.
remedy: The affected nuts on the rear axle will be replaced on affected vehicles.

concern: THE RUBBERISED FUEL RETURN HOSE ASSEMBLY MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED
defect: The rubberised fuel return hose assembly may have been incorrectly manufactured.
remedy: Inspect the date code on the fuel return pipe and replace the part if necessary.

concern: THE RUBBERISED FUEL RETURN HOSE ASSEMBLY MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED
defect: The rubberised fuel return hose assembly may have been incorrectly manufactured.
remedy: Inspect the date code on the fuel return pipe and replace the part if necessary.

concern: ON CERTAIN FRONT WHEEL DRIVE VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH AN ADDITIONAL TRACTION BATTERY THE ATTACHMENT BOLTS ON THE FRAME OF THIS HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY COULD BE LOOSE
defect: On certain front-wheel-drive vehicles equipped with an additional traction battery the attachment bolts on the frame of this high voltage battery could be loose.
remedy: Tighten the screwing of the high voltage battery module on the affected vehicles according to the respective specification.

concern: DUE TO INSUFFICIENT CONTACT OF THE BATTERY EARTH STUD TO THE CHASSIS THE VEHICLE MAY EXHIBIT VARIOUS ELECTRICAL FAULTS
defect: Due to insufficient contact of the battery earth stud to the chassis the vehicle may exhibit various electrical faults.
remedy: Replace the earth stud with a bespoke aftermarket specification part.

concern: THE OPERATION OF THE BRAKE VACUMN PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED DUE TO MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT
defect: The operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected due to material detaching from the timing belt.
remedy: Check and if necessary replace the timing belt and other components of the braking assistance system including the vacuum pump. Additionally alter servicing schedules depending on usage.

concern: VEHICLE MAY BE EQUIPPED AND FITTED WITH THE INCORRECT REAR RIGHT BRAKE CALIPER
defect: Vehicle may be equipped and fitted with the incorrect rear right brake Caliper.
remedy: Visual inspection of the rear right brake Caliper to check the ��date of manufacture�� code. Replace the caliper if affected.

concern: THE ALIGNMENT OF THE GEAR TEETH ON THE LICENSE PLATE HOLDER AND SWING ARM MAY BE INADEQUATE
defect: The alignment of the gear teeth on the license plate holder and swingarm may be inadequate.
remedy: Check the mounting position of the license plate holder and realign if required.

concern: NUTS FITTED IN THE BOLTED CONNECTION OF THE RIGHT AND LEFT TRANSVERSE LINK MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFCATION
defect: Nuts of deviating material quality were fitted in the bolted connection of the right and left transverse link on the bottom of the multi-link rear axle.
remedy: The nuts of the right and left transverse link on the bottom of the multi-link rear axle will be replaced.

concern: A MICROPROCESSOR FAULT IN THE AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT CAN LEAD TO FAULTY OPERATING CONDITIONS
defect: A microprocessor fault in the airbag control unit can lead to faulty operating conditions.
remedy: The airbag control unit will be replaced.

concern: THE REINFORCEMENT RING (THIMBLE) MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SECURELY CRIMPED ONTO THE BELT TENSIONER'S STEEL CABLE
defect: The reinforcement ring (thimble) may not have been securely crimped onto the belt tensioner's steel cable.
remedy: Check the belt buckle and if necessary conduct replacement of the lower strap including belt tensioner.

concern: THE AIR CONDITIONING DRAIN HOSES MIGHT BE INCORRECTLY FITTED IN THE VEHICLE
defect: The air conditioning drain hoses might be incorrectly fitted in the vehicle.
remedy: Conduct a check of the air conditioning drain hoses and correct their installation if necessary.

concern: TAKATA AIR BAG INFLATOR COULD RUPTURE
defect: Driver airbags equipped with non-desiccated ammonium-nitrate airbag inflators in certain climatic circumstances could over time develop a chemical alteration of the propellant.
remedy: Replace the driver�s airbag and diode in potentially affected vehicles.

concern: TAKATA AIR BAG INFLATOR COULD RUPTURE
defect: Driver airbags equipped with non-desiccated ammonium-nitrate airbag inflators in certain climatic circumstances could over time develop a chemical alteration of the propellant.
remedy: Replace the driver�s airbag in potentially affected vehicles

concern: THE STOCK CVT AIR INTAKE MAY BECOME COMPLETELY OBSTRUCTED WHEN VEHICLES ARE EQUIPPED WITH A TRACK KIT AND USED IN SNOW
defect: The stock CVT air intake may become completely obstructed when vehicles are equipped with a track kit and used in snow.
remedy: BRP will reimburse or pay for the installation of a CVT air intake relocating kit.

concern: IMPROVED EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING IN THE EMS
defect: Error in emission control readings.
remedy: Carry out update to EMS and SW software.

concern: OIL FROM THE TURBO CHARGER BEARINGS CAN PASS OVER THE COMPRESSOR SIDE OF THE TURBO AND INTO THE ENGINE AIR INTAKE
defect: A risk of an unwanted engine acceleration or an engine failure due to a hydraulic lock caused by oil from the turbo charger bearings passing over to the compressor side of the turbo.
remedy: Replace the turbocharger before oil carry over becomes critical. Increase engine idle speed to 650 rpm modify idle shutdown to 5 minutes at above 40 C and replace the DPF differential pressure sensor.

concern: INCORRECT LOCATION INFORMATION MAY BE SENT FROM THE eCALL SYSTEM
defect: Incorrect location information may be sent from the eCall system.
remedy: A software update is required to SYNC module.

concern: THE LOWER TRAILING ARMS ON THE RIGHT FRONT AXLE MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: There is a possibility that the right front lower trailing arms do not meet the required specifications.
remedy: The lower trailing arm on the right front axle must be replaced on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION MODULE COULD LEAK OVER TIME
defect: The Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) Module could leak over time�and cause thermal incident.
remedy: The EGR cooler will be internally inspected with an endoscope and replaced if evidence of leaking is found.

concern: DUE TO AN INAPPROPRIATE SOFTWARE THE SKID CONTROL ECU MAY NOT COMPLETE ALL ITS PROCESSING TASKS
defect: Due to an inappropriate software the Skid Control ECU may not complete all its processing tasks.
remedy: Reprogram the Skid control ECU.

concern: A MANUFACTURING ISSUE COULD PREVENT THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL FROM RETURNING TO ITS RESTING POSITION
defect: Inconsistent fitment of the fuse box and the electrical harness may prevent the accelerator pedal from returning to its resting position.
remedy: Check and if necessary rework the A-post lower trim ensuring correct clearance of the trim to the accelerator pedal.

concern: THE ROOF LINING STIFFENING PLATES MAY NOT BE BONDED CORRECTLY
defect: The roof lining stiffening plates may not be bonded correctly.
remedy: The roof headliner will be inspected and reworked or replaced if required.

concern: FUEL TANK STRAP BOLTS WERE NOT MANUFACTURED TO THE CORRECT HARDNESS SPECIFICATION
defect: Fuel tank strap bolts were not manufactured to the correct hardness specification.
remedy: Fit replacement bolt fixing and torque to the specified load.

concern: THE LOCK WASHER OF THE PIN JOINING THE BRAKE PEDAL TO THE BEARING PEDESTAL COULD COME LOOSE
defect: The lock washer of the pin joining the brake pedal to the bearing pedestal could come loose.
remedy: Provide additional securement of the bearing pedestal to the brake pedal by means of fitting an additional retaining ring.

concern: FUEL HOSE COULD PERISH OVER TIME
defect: Fuel hose may not be to correct specification.
remedy: Check and if necessary replace the affected fuel hose.

concern: THE RIGHT REAR BRAKE CALLIPER MIGHT NOT BE BUILT TO SPECIFICATION
defect: The right rear brake calliper might not be built to specification.
remedy: Check the production date stamp of the right rear brake calliper and replace the brake calliper if necessary.

concern: THE FRONT LOWER BALL JOINT LOCATING BOLT AND FIXING NUT MIGHT HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED OR NOT FITTED CORRECTLY
defect: The front lower ball-joint locating bolt and fixing nut might have been incorrectly tightened or not fitted correctly.
remedy: Replace the bolts and fixing nuts that attach both of the front lower ball joints to the front hub assemblies.

concern: THE REAR WHEEL HUB SHOCK ABSORBER AND BRAKE CALIPER ARE POSSIBLY NOT TIGHTENED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION
defect: The rear wheel hub the shock absorber and the brake calliper are possibly not tightened according to specification.
remedy: Check the affected bolted connections on the rear axle for correct tightening torque application and replace affected components if necessary.

concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system on the affected vehicles.

concern: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE 15AMP FUSE COULD BLOW WHICH WILL PREVENT THE LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP FROM OPERATING
defect: There is a risk that the 15amp fuse could blow which will prevent the low pressure fuel pump operating.
remedy: Replace the 15A fuse with a 20A fuse which can withstand this peak.

concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH A HINGED TOWING BRACKET ON WHICH THE LOCKING MECHANISM IN THE HINGE MODULE COULD BE FAULTY
defect: Vehicles may have been fitted with a hinged towing bracket on which the locking mechanism in the hinge module could be faulty.
remedy: The hinge module for the towing bracket must be checked and where necessary replaced on the vehicles affected.

concern: A TOW BAR WITH A POSSIBLY DEFECTIVE LOCKING MECHANISM IN THE SWIVELLING MODULE HAS BEEN FITTED
defect: A tow bar with a possibly defective locking mechanism in the swivelling module has been fitted.
remedy: The tow bar has to be checked and if necessary the swivelling module of the tow bar replaced.

concern: POSSIBLE POOR CONDUCTION BY CORROSION OF THE SPEEDOMETER ASSEMBLY
defect: Due to�an�insufficient corrosion resistance of the inner parts of the speedometer assembly�corrosion�may cause poor conduction and�a�power supply loss to�the speed sensor
remedy: Replace�the speedometer assembly

concern: FUEL PIPES CHAFFING MIGHT CAUSE ABNORMAL WEAR AND CONSEQUENTLY FUEL LEAKAGES
defect: Fuel pipes chaffing might cause abnormal wear and consequently fuel leakages
remedy: Visual inspection adding protection on the fuel pipe replace pipe if applicable.

concern: THE SOFTWARE AND HARDWARE OF THE PARKING CONTROL UNIT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The software and hardware of the parking control unit might not meet specifications.
remedy: Replace the parking control unit on the affected vehicles.

concern: IF THE BATTERY CABLE CONNECTION HAS BEEN MOUNTED INCORRECTLY THIS MAY LEAD TO A GROUND FAULT
defect: The battery cables may be mounted incorrectly
remedy: The battery cable connections have to be checked and modified if required.

concern: IF THE BATTERY CABLE CONNECTION HAS BEEN MOUNTED INCORRECTLY THIS MAY LEAD TO A GROUND FAULT
defect: The battery cables may be mounted incorrectly.
remedy: The battery cable connections have to be checked and modified if required.

concern: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT A CRACK FORMATION COULD OCCUR ON THE ENGINE CYLINDER BORES
defect: There is a possibility that a crack formation could occur on the engine cylinder bores.
remedy: The engine on the affected vehicles will be replaced.

concern: POSSIBLE LACK OF COTTER PIN OR WRONG COTTER PIN ASSEMBLY ON STEERING AXLE
defect: Possible lack of cotter pin on steering axle or possible wrong cotter pin assembly on steering axle.
remedy: Check and re-torque the nut and replacement of the cotter pin on the steering track rod.

concern: CRACKS COULD BE PRESENT IN THE CYLINDER BORE OF SPECIFIC V8 ENGINES
defect: Cracks could be present in the cylinder bore of specific V8 engines.
remedy: Replace the engine of affected vehicles

concern: THE NUT OF THE ECCENTRIC SCREW COULD BREAK ON THE REAR AXLE LOWER LEVER ARM
defect: The nut of the eccentric screw could break on the rear axle lower lever arm which may cause alterations in the wheel alignment of the rear axle.
remedy: Replace with new known correct nuts from outside identified manufacturing batches. If the screw connection is already damaged this will additionally be replaced.

concern: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION COOLER COULD DEVELOP AN INTERNAL COOLANT LEAK
defect: A possibility that the Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) cooler could develop an internal coolant leak
remedy: Replace the EGR cooler in all involved vehicles and if necessary replace the inlet manifold.

concern: A FUEL LEAK MAY OCCUR DUE TO A CHAFING CONDITION BETWEEN THE FUEL FEED HOSE AND THE CAMSHAFT COVER
defect: A fuel leak may occur due to a chafing condition between the fuel feed hose and the camshaft cover.
remedy: Check the fuel feed hose replace it if damaged and add a protection to the hose to prevent a future chafing condition.

concern: THE BONDING BETWEEN THE GLASS PANEL AND THE SLIDING ROOF FRAME MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The bonding between the glass panel and the sliding roof frame might not meet specifications.
remedy: Check the glass panel bonding on the affected vehicles and replace the sliding roof if necessary.

concern: THE STEERING KNUCKLES MAY DEFORM AFFECTING THE STEERING PERFORMANCE
defect: The steering knuckles may deform affecting the steering performance.
remedy: Replace the front knuckle steering at both sides of all potentially affected vehicles.

concern: THE RETAINING WASHER ON THE BOLT CONNECTING THE BRAKE PEDAL TO ITS BEARING BLOCK COULD COME LOOSE
defect: The retaining washer on the bolt connecting the brake pedal to its bearing block could come loose.
remedy: Secure the bearing bracket on the brake pedal by means of an additional retaining ring on the affected vehicles.

concern: THERE MAY BE A MALFUNCTION OF THE NEUTRAL POSITION SWITCH ON VEHICLES WITH A MANUAL TRANSMISSION
defect: The parking brake may be released due to an electrical fault in the neutral position switch.
remedy: Change parameter in Electronic Air-Processing Unit (EAPU) control unit.

concern: TOOL MARKS MAY OCCUR ON THE OIL PRESSURE LINE OF THE TURBOCHARGER WHICH MAY CAUSE AN OIL LEAK
defect: Tool marks may occur on the oil pressure line of the turbocharger which may cause an oil leak.
remedy: Replacement of the oil pressure line of the turbocharger.

concern: SEAT BELT D RING
defect: Front Seat belt top loop may not be secured correctly.
remedy: Check and secure the top loop as necessary.

concern: THE BRAKE CALLIPER BOLTS MAY NOT BE SECURED TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION
defect: The brake calliper bolts may not be secured to the correct specification.
remedy: Check and secure the brake calliper bolts to correct specification.

concern: THE HYDRAULIC HOSE OF THE FAN HYDRAULICS MAY DEVELOP A LEAK DUE TO A FAULTY CRIMPING
defect: The hydraulic hose of the fan hydraulics may develop a leak due to a faulty crimping.
remedy: Replace the hydraulic hose of the fan hydraulics.

concern: THE ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT WITHIN THE HECU MAY EXPERIENCE A SHORT CIRCUIT CONDITION
defect: The electrical circuit within the HECU may experience a short circuit condition that results in excessive current.
remedy: Install new fuses on affected vehicles and software update for cars equipped with Electronic Parking Brake (EPB).

concern: DURING BRAKEOPERATION THE BRAKE VALVE MAY ALLOW A SUDDEN SPIKE IN VOLTAGE WHICH MAY FEEDBACK THROUGH THE DRAWING VEHICLES CONTROL SYSTEMS.
defect: Wiring design for Wabco valve on affected trailers utilises the brake light circuit. During BRAKE operation this design may allow a sudden spike in voltage which may feedback through the drawing vehicles control systems.
remedy: Install a line protector to prevent excess voltage feeding back through the brake light circuit.

concern: SOME VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH AN ADDITIONAL BOLT THAT MAY BE LOOSE WITHIN THE ELECTRIC POWER ASSISTED STEERING
defect: Some vehicles may have been built with an additional bolt that may be loose within the Electric Power Assisted Steering (EPAS).
remedy: Replace the steering gear on all vehicles affected.

concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN ISSUE WITH THE CURRENT SOFTWARE THAT CONTOLS THE FUNTIONALITY OF THE ECALL SYSTEM
defect: Vehicles may have an issue with the current software that controls the functionality of the eCall system.
remedy: Carry out a software update.

concern: THE INSTALLATION POSITION OF THE CLAMPS FOR THE HYDRAULIC HOSES OF THE POWER STEERING MAY NOT BE CORRECT
defect: The installation position of the clamps for the hydraulic hoses of the power steering may not be correct.
remedy: Check the hydraulic hoses and clamps of the power steering and replace with new clamps if required.

concern: THE EMERGENCY LOCKING RETRACTOR IN THE FRONT RIGHT HAND SIDE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY
defect: The Emergency Locking Retractor (ELR) in the front right hand side seat belt assembly may not function correctly.
remedy: Inspect the seat belt assembly and replace if required.

concern: THE EMERGENCY LOCKING RETRACTOR IN THE FRONT RIGHT HAND SIDE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY
defect: The Emergency Locking Retractor (ELR) in the front right hand side seat belt assembly may not function correctly.
remedy: Inspect the seat belt assembly and replace if required.

concern: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOX MONITORING TO CONFIRM THE LEGAL REQUIREMENTS ARE MET
defect: The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
remedy: Update EMS software.

concern: VEHICLE ROOF BARS WERE PREVIOUSLY RECORDED AS BEING NON-LOAD BEARING
defect: Vehicle roof bars were previously recorded as being non-load bearing.
remedy: Confirmation of vehicle roof being capable of carrying 35kg to be sent to dealers and customers

concern: THE SCREW CONNECTION OF THE FRONT SEAT BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLY TO THE SEAT FRAME MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED PROPERLY
defect: The screw connection of the front seat belt buckle assembly to the seat frame may not be tightened properly.
remedy: On affected vehicles the screw connection of the lower belt of the front seats will be checked and if necessary reworked.

concern: THE ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT WITHIN THE HECU MAY EXPERIENCE A SHORT CIRCUIT CONDITION
defect: The electrical circuit within the HECU may experience a short circuit condition that results in excessive current.
remedy: Replace the multi fuse assembly with a lower amperage version & replace the junction box cover.

concern: THE BRAKE PEDAL BOX IS NOT ASSEMBLED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS

remedy: Check the assembly date range and replace the brake pedal box if affected.

concern: THE CONNECTION OF THE GAS LINES OF THE INERTISATION SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS

remedy: The lock nuts on the axle trailing arms of the rear axle must be replaced with nuts manufactured in accordance with the specifications.

defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

concern: THE CORROSION PROTECTION OF THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY HOUSING MAY NOT BE SUFFICIENT
defect: The corrosion protection of the high-voltage battery housing may not be sufficient.
remedy: Inspect clean and wax the housing of the high-voltage batteries. In cases of existing significant corrosion an affected battery module would be renewed.

concern: DUE TO ENGINE VIBRATION THE FILAMENT INSIDE THE HEADLAMP BULB MAY FAIL IN A SHORT PERIOD OF TIME
defect: Due to engine vibration the filament inside the headlamp bulb may fail in a short period of time
remedy: Carry out a headlamp bulb replacement

concern: THE SCREW CONNECTION OF THE POWER SUPPLY ON THE STARTER MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The screw connection of the power supply on the starter motor might not have been installed according to specifications.
remedy: Check the screw connections of the starter motor and the position of the plus wire on the affected vehicles and correct them if necessary.

concern: POSSIBLE LACK OF COTTER PIN OR WRONG COTTER PIN ASSEMBLY ON STEERING AXLE
defect: Possible incorrect or missing cotter pin on steered axle joint.
remedy: Check and re-torque the nut and replacement of the cotter pin on the steering rod.

concern: THE LEFT CUSHION CONNECTING PLATE MAY BE INSTALLED WITH THE INSIDE AND OUTSIDE SURFACES REVERSED
defect: The left cushion connecting plate may be installed with the inside and outside surfaces reversed.
remedy: The motorcycle will be inspected and if the connecting plate is incorrectly installed the connecting plate will be replaced.

concern: SOME VALVE GUIDES COULD BE SUBJECT TO EARLY WEAR
defect: Some valve guides could be subject to early wear
remedy: Either replace the engine or cylinder heads.

concern: VEHICLES MAY BE EQUIPPED WITH PORTABLE FIRE EXTINGUISHES WHICH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH A LOCK NUT ON THE STRIKE KNOB
defect: Vehicles may be equipped with portable fire extinguishers which may not be fitted with a lock nut on the strike knob.
remedy: Conduct a check of potentially affected fire extinguishers to establish if the lock nut is in place and if necessary have the fire extinguisher replaced.

concern: THE SIDE SPOILERS AT THE TAILGATE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MOUNTED TO SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The side spoilers at the tailgate might not have been mounted according to specifications.
remedy: Check the mounting of the side spoilers and replace them if necessary.

concern: THE FRONT FENDER WHEEL ARCH COVERS MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN MOUNTED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The wheel arch covers on the front fenders might not have been mounted according to specifications.
remedy: Check the mounting of the front wheel arch covers on the affected vehicles and correct their installation if necessary.

concern: THE TWO GRAB HANDLES ON THE LEFT SIDE OF THE HEADLINER MAY NOT BE ATTACHED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The two grab handles on the left side of the headliner might not be attached according to specifications.
remedy: Inspect the mounting of the grab handles on the left side of the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary.

concern: THE ELECTRONIC POWER STEERING FUNCTION MAY NOT BE AVAILABLE
defect: The Electronic Power Steering function may not be available.
remedy: Replacement of steering rack.

concern: THE CONTROL RING OF THE BACKREST RECLINER IN THE SECOND SEAT ROW MAY BREAK
defect: The control ring of the recliner of the backrest in the second seat row may break due to insufficient material performance.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the seat frames of the second seat row will be replaced.

concern: INCORRECT HEADREST RODS MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN THE BACKREST OF THE SECOND ROW OF SEATS ON THE OUTER SIDE
defect: Incorrect headrest rods may have been installed in the backrest of the second row of seats on the outer side.
remedy: On affected vehicles the outer headrest of the second seat row will be checked and replaced if necessary.

concern: THE FRONT PASSENGER MAIN FRONTAL AIR BAG COULD SPLIT AT THE SEAM AND MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY WHEN ACTIVATED IN A COLLISION
defect: The front passenger main frontal airbag could split at the seam and may not deploy correctly when the airbag is activated in a collision.
remedy: Replace the airbag with an improved version

concern: THE FUEL SUPPLY PIPE MAY CONTACT THE CYLINDER HEAD COVER
defect: Contact of the fuel supply pipe with the cylinder head cover causing pipe wear.
remedy: Carry out a visual inspection of the fuel supply pipe and fit a pipe protector. If necessary replace the fuel supply pipe.

concern: FRONT TYRES OUTER TREAD MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED
defect: Front tyres outer tread may have been damaged.
remedy: Check and replace tyre if required

concern: IT MAY NOT BE POSSIBLE TO ENGAGE THE HANDBRAKE LEVER
defect: It may not be possible to engage the handbrake lever.
remedy: Check the handbrake lever locking mechanism and if necessary replace the handbrake lever.

concern: THE ENGINE TONE WHEEL WHICH PROVIDES A SIGNAL TO THE CRANKSHAFT POSITION SENSOR MAY FAIL
defect: The engine tone wheel which provides a signal to the crankshaft position sensor may fail.
remedy: Replace the engine tone wheel.

concern: POTENTIAL ELECTRICAL SHORT IN THE LITHIUM-ION BATTERY
defect: Potential electrical short in the lithium-ion battery.
remedy: Initial step to limit the charge state followed by eventual complete replacement of the battery assembly.

concern: OCCASIONAL ABRASION MAY OCCUR ON BOTH FUEL LINES AT THE FRONT OF THE TANK DURING OPERATION
defect: Occasional abrasion may occur on both fuel lines at the front of the fuel tank during operation.
remedy: Both fuel lines must be replaced as a precautionary measure.

concern: THE WELDING OF THE INDIVIDUAL COMPONENTS OF THE TOWBAR MIGHT NOT MEET THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION
defect: The welding of the individual components of the towbar might not meet the correct specification.

remedy: Check the identity label and replace the tow bar if affected.

concern: FAULT IN THE AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE SOFTWARE
defect: Due to a fault in the airbag control module software the airbag system may fail to be active without this being indicated on the instrument panel.
remedy: Carry out an update to the airbag control module and instrument panel software.

concern: THE REAR RAIL ASSEMBLY MAY NOT HAVE THE SPECIFIED STRUCTURAL STRENGTH
defect: The rear rail assembly (rear longitudinal armatures) installed as part of an aftermarket repair may not have the specified structural strength.
remedy: Replacement parts will be installed in line with aftermarket welding standards.

concern: THE FIXINGS CONNECTING THE EXHAUST DOWNPIPE TO THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED TO THE SPECIFIED TORQUE VALUE
defect: The fixings connecting the exhaust downpipe to the catalytic converter may not have been tightened to the specified torque value.
remedy: Inspect the exhaust downpipe to catalytic converter joint. If the fixings are present torque them up to the required torque specification. If any fixings are missing they will be replaced and torqued to the required specification.

concern: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY OF THE FUEL RETURN PIPE DIESEL FUEL LEAKS MAY OCCUR
defect: Due to a nonconformity of the fuel return pipe diesel fuel leaks may occur.
remedy: Check the conformity of the fuel return pipe and if necessary replace.

concern: THE PRELOAD FORCE OF THE PISTON RETURN SPRING IN THE FRONT MASTER CYLINDER MAY LIE OUTSIDE THE SPECIFIED TOLERANCE
defect: The preload force of the piston return-spring in the front master cylinder may in individual cases lie outside the specified tolerance.
remedy: Replace the piston return-spring with a longer and harder spring.

concern: INDIVIDUAL SCREW CONNECTIONS OF THE SHOCK ABSORBERS ON THE FRONT AND REAR AXLE MAY HAVE BEEN IMPERMISSIBLY TIGHTENED SEVERAL TIMES
defect: Individual screw connections of the shock absorbers on the front axle and rear axle may have been impermissibly tightened several times.
remedy: The affected fastening screws must be replaced and tightened according to the original specifications. On vehicles where the front axle is affected the mounting saddles must also be replaced.

concern: WHEEL HUB CAPS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION
defect: Wheel hub caps may not have been manufactured according to specification.
remedy: Replace the wheel hub caps on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE VARIANT OF SPARK PLUGS INSTALLED MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The variant of spark plugs installed may not meet specifications.
remedy: Replace the spark plugs on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOX MONITORING TO CONFIRM THE LEGAL REQUIREMENTS ARE MET
defect: The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
remedy: Update EMS software

concern: THE ENGINE PRE-HEATER RELAY MAY OVERHEAT AND FAIL
defect: The engine pre-heater relay may overheat and fail due to short circuit between the 24V and ground on the printed circuit board (PCB).
remedy: Modify pre-heater relay harness by connection of extension cable with fuse. Replace pre-heater relay as required.

concern: THE WHEEL BOLTS MAY HAVE AN INCOMPLETE THREAD
defect: On affected vehicles the wheel bolts may have an incomplete thread.
remedy: Check and if necessary replace the wheel bolts.

concern: THE BRAKE PEDAL MAY POTENTIALLY STICK AS A RESULT OF HIGH VEHICLE INTERIOR TEMPERATURES
defect: The brake pedal may potentially stick as a result of high vehicle interior temperatures causing the brake lights to activate without brake pedal pressure.
remedy: To reprogram the electronic brake control module (EBCM) to enable a warning message to display.

concern: VEHICLE SEATBELTS MAY HAVE A DEFECTIVE LOW G LOCKING MECHANISM
defect: Vehicle seatbelts may have a defective low G locking mechanism.
remedy: Inspect the seat belt label for date range. If within suspect range exchange seat belt retractor.

concern: CONTACT OF THE FUEL SUPPLY HOSE WITH THE CLYNDER HEAD COVER CAUSING HOSE WEAR
defect: Contact of the fuel supply hose with the cylinder head cover causing hose wear.
remedy: Carry out a visual inspection of the fuel supply hose and fit a protective sleeve. If necessary replace the fuel supply hose.

concern: THE KNEE ROLL AIR BAG WIRING WAS CROSSED AT THE AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE CONNECTOR
defect: The knee roll airbag wiring may be incorrect at the Airbag Control Module connector.
remedy: Correct the wiring at the Airbag Control Module Connector.

concern: NEW SOFTWARE REQUIRED TO IMPROVE THE EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING
defect: The current software does not provide sufficient emissions control and monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on emissions are met.
remedy: Update EMS software

concern: THE LOWER NUT THAT SECURES THE CAB TILT CYLINDER TO A MOUNTING BRACKET MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY TIGHTENED
defect: The lower nut that secures the cab tilt cylinder to a mounting bracket may not be correctly tightened.
remedy: Check and ensure the tightening torque of the affected nut.

concern: THE RIGHT HAND FRONT SUPPLEMENTARY RESTRAINT SEATBELT PRE TENSIONER WILL NOT FUNCTION UNLESS THE LEFT HAND FRONT SEAT IS OCCUPIED
defect: The right hand front (RHF) (driver�s side) supplementary restraint seatbelt pre-tensioner will not function unless the left hand front seat (LHF) (passenger�s side) is occupied.
remedy: Dealers will re-orient the connections to align with the respective seating positions.

concern: THE ADDITIONAL LOCK FOR THE CONNECTOR OF THE SEAT BELT TENSIONER WIRING HARNESS IN THE CO DRIVER'S SEAT BENCH MAY NOT BE LOCKED
defect: The additional lock for the connector of the seat belt tensioner wiring harness in the co-driver�s seat bench may not be locked.
remedy: Check the condition of the additional lock and if necessary lock correctly.

concern: THE STATUTORY PLATE LABEL MAY BE MISSING THE WHOLE VEHICLE TYPE APPROVAL (WVTA) NUMBER
defect: The statutory plate label maybe missing the Whole Vehicle Type Approval (WVTA) number.
remedy: Replace the statutory plate Label with a new statutory plate label containing the WVTA number.

concern: VEHICLES HAVE BEEN DELIVERED WITH AN OPERATING MANUAL THAT DOESN'T CONTAIN A WARNING NOTICE FOR THE EXCLUSIVE USE OF AN APPROVED CHARGING CABLE FOR CHARGING…
defect: Vehicles have been delivered with an operating manual that doesn�t contain a warning notice for the exclusive use of an approved charging cable for charging the high-voltage (HV) battery.
remedy: Attach a supplementary sheet with a corresponding warning notice in the operation manual for the affected vehicles.

concern: THE RESCUE CUTTING LINE LOCATED IN THE SEAT BOX OF THE DRIVER SEAT MAY NOT BE ACCESSIBLE
defect: The rescue cutting line located in the seat box of the driver seat may not be accessible.
remedy: Reposition the rescue loop on affected vehicles.

concern: AN INCORRECT FUSE TYPE FOR THE ELECTRIC SYSTEM OF THE AIR SUSPENSION COULD HAVE BEEN MOUNTED BY ERROR
defect: The fuse for the electric system for the air suspension may be incorrectly specified.
remedy: Check the currently installed fuse and control unit on the potentially affected vehicles and replace if necessary. Also replace the fuse assignment booklet if necessary.

concern: INTERNAL CONTACT FAILURE INSIDE THE WIPER SYSTEM MOTORS CAN CAUSE ISSUES WITH THE SYNCHRONISATION
defect: Synchronized wipers may fail and become stuck.
remedy: Check Wiper motors and replace if within the affected range.

concern: THE POWERED TAILGATE MAY PARTIALLY LOWER UNEXPECTEDLY FROM THE FULLY OPENED POSITION IN CERTAIN SITUATIONS
defect: The powered tailgate may partially lower unexpectedly from the fully opened position in certain situations.
remedy: Inspect the production information and update the software of the power tailgate drive unit. Where necessary replace the power tailgate drive unit.
