concern: THE GEAR RECOGNITION FUNCTION IN THE TRANSMISSION COULD NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED
defect: The reverse gear light may occasionally be non-functional until the next ignition change or the next engine start.
remedy: Update the software responsible for gear recognition on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE AND THE CONTROL UNIT CABLE MAY HAVE BEEN MIXED UP
defect: The positive battery cable and the cable to the control unit for battery monitoring on the main fuse box in the boot may have been mixed up.
remedy: Inspect the two connected cables on the main fuse box and if necessary swap them into the correct positions.

concern: INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF THE REAR WHEEL HUB BOLTS
defect: Noises may come from the rear wheel brake and wheel pinion socket due to incorrect tightening of the rear wheel hub bolts.
remedy: Replace the affected rear wheel hub bolts.

concern: CRACKS MAY OCCUR WITHIN THE MICROSTRUCTURE OF THE HANDLEBAR CLAMPS
defect: Cracks can cause the handlebar clamp to break off together with the mounted clip-on handlebars.
remedy: The handlebar mounts and clip-on handlebars must be replaced on all vehicles.

concern: DRIVER'S AIR BAG WARNING LIGHT DOESN'T SWITCH ON
defect: Driver's airbag warning light doesn't switch on in case of problems relating to the airbag system and related wiring.
remedy: Update vehicle software.

concern: SERVICE DOORS NOT OPENING WITH EMERGENCY CONTROLS
defect: Service doors not opening with emergency controls.
remedy: Carry out a software update

concern: THE SOFTWARE OF CERTAIN COMMUNICATION MODULES MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The software of certain communication modules may not meet specifications.
remedy: Carry out an update to the software of the communication module on affected vehicles.

concern: THE COMMUNICATION MODULE MAY BE DEACTIVATED
defect: The communication module may be deactivated
remedy: Carry out a check of the configuration of the communication module on affected vehicles and if necessary activate the communication module.

concern: THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG MAY TEAR DURING INFLATION
defect: The drivers� bag may tear during inflation.
remedy: Replace the drivers� airbag of all potentially affected vehicles.

concern: THE MATING SURFACES OF THE PROPSHAFT FLANGES MAY BE CONTAMINATED WITH PAINT
defect: The mating surfaces of the propshaft flanges may be contaminated with paint.
remedy: Remove the propshaft inspect and clean the flanges. Refit with new fixings.

concern: THE RETRACTOR OF THE THREE POINT AUTOMATIC SEAT BELT ON THE FRONT RIGHT SEAT MAY BE FAULTY.
defect: The retractor of the three-point automatic seat belt on the front right seat may be faulty.
remedy: The three-point automatic seat belt of the front right seat is to be replaced.

concern: THE REAR DRIVE SHAFTS MAY NOT FULFIL THE DURABILITY REQUIREMENTS
defect: The rear drive shafts may not fulfil the durability requirements.
remedy: On the affected vehicles one or both output shafts will be replaced.

concern: THE FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MIGHT NOT INFLATE FULLY IN THE EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT
defect: In the event of an accident requiring the vehicle�s front passenger airbag to be activated the airbag might not inflate fully.
remedy: The dash panel must be checked on the affected vehicles and repaired or replaced if required

concern: A SETTING OF THE SOFTWARE PARAMETER FOR THE REMOTE DRIVE EXTERNAL PARKING BRAKE REQUEST IS SET TO AN ERRONEOUS VALUE
defect: A setting of the software parameter for the remote drive external parking brake request is set to an erroneous value.
remedy: Software update.

concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN ENGINE COOLING RADIATOR AIR INTAKE MODULE SEALING BAFFLE MISSING
defect: Vehicles may have an engine cooling radiator air intake module sealing baffle missing.
remedy: Install the missing radiator air intake sealing baffle.

concern: A FUEL PUMP RELAY WHICH COULD OPERATE INTERMITTENTLY OR FAIL WITHOUT WARNING
defect: A fuel pump relay which could operate intermittently or fail without warning.
remedy: Replace the affected fuel pump and modify original wiring where necessary

concern: CONNECTING RODS INSTALLED MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
defect: Connecting rods that were not manufactured according to specifications may have been installed in the engines of the affected vehicles.
remedy: The engine must be replaced.

concern: THE THREADED CONNECTIONS OF THE UPPER CONTROL ARMS AT THE REAR AXLE WERE NOT TIGHTENED WITH THE SPECIFIC TIGTENING TORQUE
defect: Threaded connections of the upper control arms at the rear axle may not be tightened with the specified tightening torque.
remedy: The chassis bolts will be replaced and tightened with the specified tightening torque.

concern: INDIVIDUAL THREADED CONNECTIONS AT THE VEHICLE'S SUSPENSION MIGHT NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE SPECIFICATION DUE TO INSUFFICIENTLY CUT THREAD OF LOCKNUTS
defect: Individual threaded connections at the vehicle's suspension might not be tightened to the specification due to insufficiently cut thread of locknuts.
remedy: The affected screw joints must be replaced with a new nut and bolt and tightened to the original specification.

concern: THE DASHBOARD MIGHT NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The dashboard might not meet specifications
remedy: Replace the dashboard on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT CANNOT DETECT AN ERROR OF ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE SENSOR
defect: The engine control unit cannot detect an error of atmospheric pressure sensor.
remedy: Affected units must have the engine control unit reprogrammed

concern: THE GROUND CONNECTION OF THE PASSENGER AIR BAG MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The ground connection of the passenger airbag might not meet specifications.
remedy: Check the ground connection of the passenger airbag and rework it if necessary.

concern: LOSS OF TORQUE OF ENGINE HOOD HINGE SCREWS MAY RESULT IN UNLATCHED HOOD
defect: Loss of torque of engine hood hinge screws may result in an unlatched hood.
remedy: Replace the hood hinge screws with ones with thread lock.

concern: AFFECTED TYRES MAY DEVELOP BULGES OR SEPARATIONS IN THE SIDEWALL AREA OF THE TYRE
defect: Affected tyres may develop bulges or separations in the sidewall area of the tyre.
remedy: Affected tyres will be replaced.

concern: DUE TO INCORRECT TYPE APPROVAL DATA PROCESSING THE MANUFACTURER'S PLATE (VIN PLATE) AND REGISTRATION DOCUMENT MUST BE REPLACED
defect: Due to incorrect type-approval data processing the manufacturer's plate (VIN plate) and registration document must be replaced.
remedy: Replace the VIN plate and update the registration document as required.

concern: THE EVAPORATIVE EMISSIONS CANISTER MAY BE UNABLE TO ABSORB THE NECESSARY AMOUNT OF FUEL VAPOUR DURING VEHICLE REFUELLING
defect: The Evaporative Emissions Canister may be unable to absorb the necessary amount of fuel vapour during vehicle refuelling.
remedy: Replace the Evaporative Emissions Canister.

concern: A HIGH HEAT COULD DEVELOP IN THE MUFFLER CAUSING THE UPPER RIGHT HAND VENT GRILL TO MELT
defect: In some specific riding conditions a high heat could develop in the muffler causing the upper right hand vent grill to melt.
remedy: Reprogram the ECM and install a heat reflective foil kit.

concern: THE REAR BRAKE CALLIPER MAY LEAK BRAKE FLUID INTO THE HOUSING OF THE ELECTRIC PARKING BRAKE
defect: The rear brake calliper may leak brake fluid into the housing of the electric parking brake.
remedy: Replace the rear brake callipers and update the ESP software.

concern: THE PASSENGER SEAT OCCUPANCY DETECTION SYSTEM DOES NOT CURRENTLY MEET THE REQUIRED STANDARD
defect: The passenger seat occupancy detection system does not currently meet the required standard.
remedy: The passenger seat occupancy detection sensor mats must be replaced.

concern: THE FRONT SEAT BELT RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH AN IMPROPERLY FORMED WAVE DISC
defect: The front seat belt retractor may have been built with an improperly formed wave disc.
remedy: Replace the front seat belt retractor.

concern: A SHORT CIRCUIT IN THE ABS CAN OCCUR WITHOUT WARNING WHEN THE ENGINE IS SWITCHED OFF
defect: A short circuit in the ABS can occur without warning when the engine is switched off.
remedy: Installing of a switch off relays to interrupt the power supply to the ABS ECU in vehicle key off condition.

concern: VEHICLES MAY BE FITTED WITH A NON CONFORM ACCESSORY TRAILER HITCH
defect: Vehicles may be fitted with a non-conform accessory trailer hitch.
remedy: Check the batch number and if necessary replace the trailer hitch.

concern: THE SEATBELT REMINDER IS NOT DISPLAYED
defect: The seatbelt reminder is not displayed.
remedy: Carry out a software update.

concern: THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MOUNTED ON THE VEHICLE IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE SPECIFICATION
defect: The accelerator pedal may not have been mounted on the vehicle in accordance with the specification.
remedy: Check the correct installation of the accelerator pedal on the affected vehicles and if necessary renew it.

concern: AFFECTED VEHICLES MAY BE FITTED WITH BRAKE DISCS WHICH ARE NOT TO SPECIFICATION
defect: Affected vehicles may be fitted with brake discs which were not produced according to the specifications
remedy: On the affected vehicles the brake discs will be checked and if necessary replaced

concern: THE BLOWER REGULATOR WIRING COULD BE DAMAGED AND COULD LEAD TO PARTIAL CONTACT OF INDIVIDUAL WIRE STRANDS
defect: The blower-regulator wiring could be damaged and could lead to partial contact of individual wire strands.
remedy: The blower regulator wiring harness will be inspected and a new part will be installed additional components will be replaced if necessary.

concern: A SOFTWARE UPDATE OF THE ELECTRONIC STABILITY PROGRAMME (ESP) CONTROL UNIT IS REQUIRED
defect: A software update of the Electronic Stability Programme (ESP) control unit is required.

concern: THE MATERIAL OF TWO CLOSURE PLUGS ON THE ENGINE MAY NOT WITHSTAND THE MAXIMUM LOADS WHILST DRIVING
defect: The material of two closure plugs on the engine might not withstand the maximum loads while driving.
remedy: Rework the closure plugs on the engine on the affected vehicles

concern: THE WIRING HARNESS UNDER THE RIGHT SEAT OF THE SECOND SEAT ROW MAY NOT BE ROUTED CORRECTLY
defect: The wiring harness under the right seat of the second seat row might not be routed according to specification.
remedy: Check the routing of the wiring harness correct it if necessary and repair any potentially existing damages on the wiring harness.

concern: THE MOUNTING OF THE GAS LINE TO THE GAS GENERATOR OF THE INERTER SYSTEM MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The mounting of an argon gas line to generator of the inerter system might not meet specifications.
remedy: Check the mounting of the gas line to the gas generator on the affected vehicles and rework it if necessary.

concern: THE CALIBRATION OF THE OCCUPANT CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM FOR THE PASSENGER SEAT MAY NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION
defect: The calibration of the occupant classification system for the passenger seat might not meet the specification.
remedy: Replace the passenger seat cushion

concern: WATER OR OIL MAY ENTER THE HYDRAULIC ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT
defect: Water or oil may enter the Hydraulic Electronic Control Unit over a long period of time causing an electrical short circuit.
remedy: Install a relay to isolate the HECU when the ignition is switched off.

concern: THE FOUR WHEEL FINAL DRIVE SCREW JOINTS TO THE TRANSMISSION MOUNT HAVE NOT BEEN TIGHTENED TO CORRECT SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The front four-wheel final drive transmission support mounts may not be tightened according to specifications.
remedy: The front-axle final drive will be removed and the transmission support will be secured according to specifications. If necessary the front-axle final drive and any other damaged components will be replaced.

concern: THE HEAT SHIELD INSTALLED AT THE TURBOCHARGER MAY NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION
defect: The heat shield installed at the turbocharger may not meet the specification
remedy: Replace the heat shield on the affected vehicles

concern: THE SEATBELT ON THE FRONT LEFT SEAT MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN MOUNTED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION.
defect: The seatbelt on the front left seat might not have been mounted according to specification
remedy: Check the routing of the seatbelt on the front left seat on the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary. If the webbing is damaged the seatbelt will be replaced.

concern: THE DIMENSION OF THE BRAKE DISCS ON THE FRONT AXLE MAY BE TOO SMALL
defect: The dimension of the brake discs installed on the front axle might be too small.
remedy: Replace the brake discs on the affected vehicles.

concern: SOME 4-POINT HARNESSES SOLD AS AN ACCESORY COULD HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH MISSING STITCHING AT ATTACHMENT POINTS
defect: Some 4-point harnesses sold as an accessory could have been manufactured with missing stitching at attachment points.
remedy: BRP is asking its dealers to contact the consumers about the recall and to bring their harnesses for inspection and if necessary a replacement.

concern: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS
defect: There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

concern: THE INNER TIE RODS ARE NOT CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION
defect: The inner tie rods connecting the steering rack to the track rod end are not correct to specification
remedy: Replace the steering rack inner tie rods (on both sides)

concern: THE INNER TIE RODS ARE NOT CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION
defect: The inner tie rods connecting the steering rack to the track rod end are not correct to specification
remedy: Replace the steering rack inner tie rods (on both sides)

concern: INCORRECT STARTER WIRING HARNESS AND HOLDER FOR FIXING THE EXHAUST SYSTEM MAY BE INSTALLED
defect: An incorrect starter wiring harness and a holder for fixing the exhaust system could be installed.
remedy: Replace the starter wiring harness and the holder for fixing the exhaust on the affected vehicles.

concern: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE INTERNAL CORROSION PROTECTION OF THE SUBFRAME IS NOT DURABLE ENOUGH.
defect: There is a possibility that the internal corrosion protection of the front subframe is not durable enough.
remedy: Replacing the front subframe assembly.

concern: POSSIBLE LEAKY CONNECTION ON THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL PUMP
defect: Possible leaky connection on the high pressure fuel pump.
remedy: Re-tighten the high pressure fuel pump and replace the fuel supply pipe.

concern: THE HEAD RESTRAINT PADDING MAY SEPARATE FROM THE FASTENING RODS
defect: The head restraint padding may separate from the fastening rod.
remedy: Replace the head restraints on the affected vehicles.

concern: INTERNAL WELDING OF THE MAIN CELL CONDUCTORS OF THE HIGH-VOLTAGE BATTERY MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: Internal welding of the main cell conductors of the high-voltage battery might not meet specification.
remedy: Replace the high-voltage battery on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE THIRD ROW SEAT HEAD RESTRAINTS MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATION
defect: The third row seat head restraints may not meet specification on affected vehicles.
remedy: Replace the head restraints on affected vehicles

concern: WIRE OF SEAT BELT BUCKLE CAN RUB AGAINST THE PLASTIC COVER
defect: Wire of seat belt buckle can rub against the plastic cover.
remedy: Replace affected buckle for new designed buckle.

concern: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM
defect: There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

concern: INCORRECT RESTRAINT BARS AND/OR HEAD RESTRAINTS MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED
defect: Bench seats in the rear may have been installed with the head restraint bars of a different bench seat and/or head restraint variant.
remedy: Check the head restraints in the rear area in the affected vehicles and replace if necessary.

concern: THERE IS THE POSSIBILITY THAT A SMALL CHILD COULD CLIMB FROM THE BUNK BED OUT THROUGH THE OPENED ROOF HATCH
defect: There is the possibility that small children could climb from the bunk bed out through the opened roof hatch.
remedy: On the affected vehicles protection against climbing out is to be fitted.

concern: SEVERAL FIXATIONS ON THE REAR AXLE COMPONENT WERE NOT TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
defect: There is a possibility that several fixations on the rear axle component were not tightened correctly.
remedy: Tighten all fixations to correct torque and replace the nuts and bolts if necessary.

concern: CERTAIN IMMI 4 POINT AND 6 POINT SEAT BELT HARNESSES MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH MISSING BELT STITCHING
defect: Certain 4-point and 6-point seat belt harnesses may have been manufactured with missing belt stitching.
remedy: Check and replace the belt assembly if required.

concern: DISTORTION OF THE FUEL TANK MAY OCCUR ON THE SEALING SURFACES IN THE AREAS SURROUNDING THE FUEL PUMP AND THE FUEL LEVEL SENSOR
defect: Distortion of the fuel tank may occur on the sealing surfaces in the areas surrounding the fuel pump and the fuel level sensor.
remedy: Fuel tanks to be replaced with an improved component.

concern: IMMI HARNESSES MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH MISSING BELT STITICHING
defect: Certain 4-point and 6-point seat belt harnesses may have been manufactured with missing belt stitching.
remedy: Check and replace the belt assembly if required.

concern: THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY CONTROL CHARGER MODULE CONNECTOR MAY BE DAMAGED
defect: The High Voltage Battery Control Charger Module (BCCM) connector may be damaged
remedy: An inspection of the BCCM is required to confirm an undamaged connector. If a failed inspection occurs the vehicle must be reworked with a replacement BCCM and charge cable.

concern: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT
defect: Premature degradation of emission control component.
remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer

concern: THE NOISE VIBRATION AND HARDNESS FOAM PAD CAN OVER TIME CORRODE THE SURFACE OF THE FUEL TANK
defect: The Noise Vibration and Harshness (NVH) foam pad underneath the fuel tank may retain moisture and corrode the fuel tank potentially causing a fuel leak
remedy: Remove the NVH foam pad from the vehicle and inspect fuel tank. Repair or replace the fuel tank if necessary.

concern: OIL COOLER HOSE POTENTIALLY HAS AN INTERNAL DEFECT AND MAY SPLIT
defect: Oil cooler hose potentially has an internal defect and may split.
remedy: Remedy is not yet confirmed. Owner to contact manufacturer.

concern: THE FUEL PIPE MAY CRACK OVER TIME
defect: Possibility that the fuel pipe may crack over time and causing it to leak fuel into the engine bay.
remedy: Replace the affected fuel pipe

concern: POTENTIAL BREAKAGE/FATIGUE OF A FLEXIBLE STEEL CABLE SUPPORTING THE FRONT SEATBELT ANCHOR POINT
defect: Potential breakage/fatigue of a flexible steel cable supporting the front seatbelt anchor point.
remedy: Replace the seat belt fastener with a new designed seat belt fastening.

concern: THERE IS A POTENTIAL FOR THE INTERNAL AGGRESSION IN THE FUEL HOSE CAUSING A FUEL LEAK
defect: There is a potential for the internal aggression in the fuel hose causing a fuel leak.
remedy: Replace the fuel supple pipe

concern: MOISTURE MAY ENTER THE BELT-DRIVEN STARTER-ALTERNATOR
defect: It is possible that moisture may enter the belt-driven starter-alternator.
remedy: The starter-alternator must be replaced on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE RUN ON WATER PUMP MAY OVERHEAT
defect: The Run On Water Pump (ROWP) fitted to Transit and Transit Custom vehicles may overheat
remedy: Replacing the 15 Amp fuse with a 7.5 Amp fuse to prevent the possibility for the ROWP to overheat.

concern: THE STRENGTH OF THE ENGINE CRANKSHAFT CONNECTING ROD MAY BE INSUFFICIENT
defect: The strength of the engine crankshaft connecting rod may be insufficient.
remedy: Check the material number and where necessary a new replacement engine will be fitted.

concern: THE OPERATING MANUAL DOES NOT SPECIFY CERTAIN CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH THE AUTOMATIC PARKING FUNCTION OF THE AUTOMATIC GEARBOX OPERATES
defect: The operating manual does not correctly specify certain conditions under which the automatic parking function (Auto-P) of the automatic gearbox operates.
remedy: Add a supplementary booklet with a correct description of the Auto-P function to the operating manual.

concern: THE GROUND TERMINAL OF THE TRAILER HITCH SOCKET MAY BE INSTALLED IN AN INCORRECT PORT
defect: The ground terminal of the trailer hitch socket might be installed in an incorrect port.
remedy: Relocate the ground terminal in the trailer hitch socket from pin location 10 to location 3.

concern: THE OPTIONAL SPEED LIMITER DOES NOT WORK
defect: The optional Speed Limiter does not work.
remedy: Reprogramming of the Engine Control Module

concern: ENGINE CODE MARKED ON DIESEL ENGINE IN AFTERSALES IS DIFFERENT FROM THE HOMOLOGATED AND PRODUCTION CODE
defect: Engine code marked on Diesel engine replaced in aftersales is different from the homologated and Production code
remedy: Documentation will be provided to the customer stating the Italian transport authority confirm this marking is an administration error.

concern: FRESHWATER TANK BRACKET SECURING BOLT HEAD MAY PULL THROUGH THE FIXING BRACKET
defect: Freshwater tank bracket securing bolt head can pull through the fixing bracket causing the tank bracket to drop.
remedy: : Add additional brackets to all four fixing bolts to stop the risk of the bolt head pulling through the original bracket.

concern: FEED KNOB STARTER SWITCH SUPPORT SPRING FAILURE COULD POSSIBLY RESULT IN IGNITION OFF WHILST VEHICLE IS IN MOTION
defect: Feed Knob Starter switch support spring failure could possibly result in ignition off whilst vehicle is in motion.
remedy: Change Starter switch harness & cover to new version if not already fitted.

concern: THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MAY HAVE BEEN EQUIPPED WITH A DEFECTIVE SENSOR FOR THE ROLLOVER DETECTION
defect: The air bag control unit may have been equipped with a defective sensor for the rollover detection.
remedy: The Airbag control unit (ACSM4i) will be replaced on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE FACTORY ECU PROGRAMMING MAY CAUSE THE ENGINE TO AFTER FIRE WHEN KAWASAKI QUICK SHIFTER IS USED UNDER HEAVY ENGINE LOAD
defect: The factory Electronic Control Unit programming may cause the engine to after fire when Kawasaki Quick Shifter is used under heavy engine load.
remedy: Reprogram the ECU. Replace the reed valves in the air suction valve assemblies on used motorcycles and if necessary replace any parts that have been heat damaged as a result of after-fire occurring.

concern: E-CALL SERVICE MAY NOT ALWAYS BE FUNCTIONAL
defect: On affected vehicles the e-call service may not function
remedy: Update the Online Control Unit software on affected vehicles

concern: THE E-CALL SERVICE FUNCTION MAY NOT ALWAYS FUNCTION
defect: On affected vehicles the e-call service may not function
remedy: Update the Online Control Unit software on affected vehicle.

concern: POSSIBLE COLLISION BETWEEN BRAKE HOSES AND WHEEL ARCH LINER AT THE FRONT AXLE
defect: Contact could occur between brake hoses and the rear segment of the front axle wing panel liner resulting in chafing.
remedy: Check the position of the wing liner & modify as per working instructions.

concern: A FRONT BRAKE PAD MAY DISLODGE UNDER BRAKING
defect: The brake pad could detach from its retaining clip and fall away from the brake disc
remedy: Fit a 3mm spacer ring to the wheel before the brake disc to prevent the pad detaching

concern: POSSIBILITY OF HUMIDITY INGRESS IN THE BOWDEN CABLES OF THE DOORS
defect: Possibility of humidity ingress in the Bowden cables of the doors due to missing seals.
remedy: Remove cables and humidity and seal off. Poznan produced cables to be replaced.

concern: THE ADHESIVE BOND BETWEEN THE SUNROOF AND THE VEHICLE BODY DOES NOT MEET SPECIFICATION
defect: A small number of vehicles may have an adhesive bond between the sunroof and the vehicle body which does not meet the specification.
remedy: The sunroof glass or sunroof assembly will be replaced.

concern: IF MOISTURE ENTERS THE ABS MODULE IT COULD CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT
defect: When the vehicle is turned off if moisture enters the ABS module it could cause an electrical short.
remedy: Affected vehicles will have a relay installed in the main fuse box to prevent power going to the ABS module when the ignition key is in the off position.

concern: THE WHEEL ARCH LINER ON THE FRONT AXLE COULD TOUCH AND CHAFE THE FLEXIBLE BRAKE HOSE
defect: The wheel arch liner on the front axle could touch and chafe the flexible brake hose.
remedy: Check the condition and clearance of the flexible brake hoses replacing them if necessary. Additionally the corresponding wheel arch liner will be modified to provide adequate clearance.

concern: UNDER BRAKING PRESSURE THE BRAKE PEDAL DEFLECTS AND CONTACTSTHE SKID PLATE INHIBITING REAR WHEEL BRAKING PERFORMANCE
defect: The brake pedal deflects under braking pressure and contacts the Skid Plate which inhibits rear wheel braking performance.
remedy: Replace the Accessory Skid Plate with a new remedial part.

concern: THE TIGHTNESS OF THE QUICK CONNECTOR OF THE FUEL SUPPLY LINE MAY NOT BE ENSURED
defect: The tightness of the quick connector of the fuel supply line may not be ensured.
remedy: The fuel supply line in the engine compartment has to be replaced.

concern: THE STEERING GEOMETRY COULD BE INCORRECTLY SET
defect: The steering geometry could be incorrectly set due to an incorrectly calibrated setting rig in the manufacturing plant.
remedy: Check the steering alignment and adjusting if set incorrectly. If the front tyres are worn these will also be replaced.

concern: THE STEERING GEOMETRY COULD BE INCORRECTLY SET
defect: The steering geometry could be incorrectly set due to an incorrectly calibrated setting rig in the manufacturing plant.
remedy: Check the steering alignment and adjusting if set incorrectly. If the front tyres are worn these will also be replaced.

concern: VEHICLES MAY NOT COMPLY WITH SPECIFIC EMISSIONS CRITERIA
defect: Vehicles may not comply with specific emissions criteria.
remedy: Carry out a SOPS software conversion or evidence exemption compliance

concern: THE FRONT BRAKE PADS FRICTION MATERIAL MAY DETACH FROM THE BACK PLATE WHEN USED IN A CORROSIVE ENVIRONMENT
defect: The front brake pads could have potential issues involving detachment of brake pad friction material from the back plate.
remedy: Replace all the affected brake pads

concern: CORROSION OF THE BRAKE CALIPERS CAN OCCUR
defect: Corrosion due to salt may cause brake bind.
remedy: Inspect and clean replace the seals or callipers as required.

concern: THE BRAKE PAD FRICTION MATERIAL MAY SEPARATE FROM THE PLATES
defect: The friction material might separate from the plates of the brake pads due to a non-conformity.
remedy: Replace the front brake pads.

concern: GEAR OIL MAY ESCAPE DUE TO A FAULTY WELDED JOINT ON THE GEARBOX OIL LINE
defect: It is possible that gear oil may escape due to a faulty welded joint on the gearbox oil line.
remedy: The production date of the gear oil line must be checked first on the vehicles affected and the gear oil line must be replaced if necessary.

concern: IF THE HEAD AIR BAG IS DEPLOYED THE IGNITOR MAY SEPARATE FROM THE INFLATOR
defect: Curtain airbags may have propellant which may have a humidity level higher than specification and in the event of a collision may not deploy correctly increasing the risk of injury.
remedy: Replace the airbags on affected vehicles.

concern: OVER TIME THE FUNCTION OF THE TAKATA NADI AIRBAG INFLATOR CAN DEGRADE DUE TO AIR AND MOISTURE INGRESS INTO THE INFLATOR MATERIAL
defect: The function of the driver airbag inflators can degrade due to air and moisture ingress.
remedy: Replace Driver air bag inflator

concern: A WELDED CONNECTION OF THE GEARBOX OIL PIPE CAN CAUSE A LEAK OF GEAR OIL
defect: A welded connection of the gearbox oil pipe can cause a leak of gear oil.
remedy: Check whether the gearbox oil pipe is within the affected production period. If this is the case the pipe is replaced.

concern: THE + WIRE OF THE GRIPTONE BATTERY CHARGING SOCKET COULD RUB THROUGH
defect: The permanent + wire (30) of the GRIPTONE battery charging socket could rub through due to a sharp edge on a fixing bracket.
remedy: The geometry of the fixing bracket will be modified to remove the possibility of the wire rubbing.

concern: AFTERMARKET REPLACEMENT PRODUCT DOES NOT HAVE NECESSARY TYPE APPROVAL
defect: Euro VI DPF replacements don�t currently have necessary type approval.
remedy: All parts to be returned to Dinex Warrington office for credit.

concern: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF THE FIXED GLASS SUNROOF WHILST DRIVING
defect: Possible detachment of the fixed glass sunroof while driving.
remedy: Check the bonding and replace if required replace the fixed glass sunroof.

concern: THE ROOF SPOILER CAN PARTIALLY OR COMPLETELY DETACH FROM THE VEHICLE
defect: The roof spoiler can partially or completely detach from the vehicle.
remedy: The roof spoiler is additionally fixed in position with bolts on the rear lid.

concern: THE FIXING OF THE FRONT WING WHEEL ARCH TRIM DOES NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION
defect: The fixing of the front wing wheel arch trim does not conform to specification.
remedy: The repair consists of adding an additional fixing screw to the bottom of the front wheel arch trim.

concern: THE FIXING OF THE FRONT WING WHEEL ARCH TRIM DOES NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION
defect: The fixing of the front wing wheel arch trim does not conform to specification.
remedy: The repair consists of adding an additional fixing screw to the bottom of the front wheel arch trim.

concern: THE UPPER STEERING COLUMN BOLT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FITTED
defect: The upper steering column bolt may not have been fitted.
remedy: Inspect the upper steering column bolt fitment and replace where necessary.

concern: THE FIXED SPEED LIMITER IS INOPERATIVE
defect: Due to the incorrect calibration of the injection computer the fixed speed limiter is inoperative.
remedy: Re-program the injection computer.

concern: BRAKE PAD MATERIAL MAY DETACH FROM THE BACK PLATE
defect: Brake pad material may detach from the back plate.
remedy: Check part number on disc pad replace if the number is the faulty part number

concern: BRAKE PAD MATERIAL MAY DETACH FROM THE BACK PLATE
defect: Brake pad material may detach from the back plate.
remedy: Check part number on disc pad replace if the number is the faulty part number.

concern: THE BONDING BETWEEN THE GLASS PANEL AND THE SLIDING ROOF FRAME MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The bonding between the glass panel and the sliding roof frame might not meet specifications
remedy: Check the glass panel bonding on the affected vehicles and replace the sliding roof if necessary

concern: THE OUTER PART OF THE AIR BAFFLE ON THE FRONT PANEL FLAP MAY BE LOOSE
defect: The outer part of the air baffle on the front panel flap could fully or partially detach from the vehicle.
remedy: Replace the outer part with one of a different supplier

concern: THE BOWDEN CABLE PIN INSIDE THE INTERNAL DOOR HANDLES MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY ENGAGED
defect: The internal door handle mechanism may fail and the door cannot be unlocked from the inside.
remedy: Replace the whole internal door handle.

concern: OWNER'S MANUALS FOR THE TRANSPORTER WERE INCLUDED INSTEAD OF FOR THE MULTIVAN
defect: On T6.1 California vehicles owner's manuals for the Transporter were included instead of for the Multivan.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the Transporter owner's manual is replaced with the Multivan owner's manual.

concern: THE FUNCTION OF THE LOCKING MECHANISM ON THE FRONT HEAD RESTRAINTS MAY BE IMPAIRED
defect: The function of the locking mechanism on the front head restraints may be impaired.
remedy: The front head restraints must be replaced on the affected vehicles

concern: TRANSMISSION FLUID PUMP GEAR FAILURE CAN CAUSE A LOSS OF HYDRAULIC FLUID PRESSURE IN THE TRANSMISSION
defect: Transmission fluid pump gear failure
remedy: Update the Transmission Control Module (TCM) and Powertrain Control Module (PCM) software

concern: THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG FABRIC COULD BE DAMAGED BY THE AIR BAG COVER DURING DEPLOYMENT
defect: This airbag fabric could be damaged by the airbag cover during deployment.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the driver�s airbag will be replaced.

concern: THE SEAT SCISSOR AND/OR GUIDE RAIL OF THE DRIVER'S SEAT CAN BREAK
defect: The seat scissor and/or guide rail of the driver's seat can break.
remedy: Check the correct installation of the securing strap on the seat scissor of the driver's seat. Fit or re-position if necessary.

concern: THE CABLE LENGTHS FOR THE ELECTRIC CONNECTION OF THE HALL SENSOR INSIDE THE SEATBELT BUCKLE COULD BE TOO SHORT
defect: The cable lengths for the electric connection of the hall sensor integrated inside the seatbelt buckle could be too short.
remedy: R; The front seat belt buckles will be checked and replaced if they are found to be faulty.

concern: DEPLOYMENT OF THE PASSENGER AIRBAG COULD DAMAGE THE INSTRUMENT PANEL
defect: Deployment of the passenger air bag could damage the instrument panel
remedy: On the affected vehicle the instrument panel trim will be replaced

concern: THE THROTTLE LEVER STOP MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING SHIPPING
defect: The throttle lever stop might have been damaged during shipping
remedy: Check for damage on the neck of the throttle lever. If damage is found the throttle lever shall be replaced.

concern: THE BRACKET OF THE DOUBLE BELT BUCKLE MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING THE FORMING PROCESS
defect: It is possible that the bracket of the double belt buckle has been damaged during the forming process.
remedy: The double belt buckle must be replaced in all affected vehicles.

concern: CRACKS MAY FORM ON HOUSING OF THE HIGH-PRESSURE SIDE OF THE GAS PRESSURE REGULATOR
defect: The natural gas regulator may develop a crack
remedy: Replace the gas regulator on affected vehicles

concern: THE DRIVEN REAR AXLE WISHBONE ON AFFECTED VEHICLES CAN CRACK
defect: The driven rear axle wishbone on affected vehicles can crack
remedy: Check affected vehicles. Change wishbone if necessary

concern: WATER CAN ACCUMULATE IN THE BOWDEN CABLES FOR THE THROTTLE VALVE
defect: Water can accumulate in the Bowden cables for the throttle valve during intensive cleaning or longer rainy trips.
remedy: On affected vehicles the Bowden cables and the Bowden cable holder on the gas handle will be replaced.

concern: THE TRANSFER CASE CONTAINS A DUAL DRIVE GEAR WHICH MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN AN INCORRECT ORIENTATION
defect: The transfer case contains a dual drive gear which may have been installed in an incorrect orientation.
remedy: Replace the transfer case.

concern: FAULTY PARAMETERIZATION OF EXHAUST GAS AFTERTREATMENT CONTROL UNIT
defect: Affected vehicles have a faulty parameterization of the �exhaust gas aftertreatment� control unit.
remedy: Programming update on the engine control unit.

concern: CONNECTING SCREWS ON THE ELECTRIC DRIVE MAY BE MISSING
defect: Connecting screws on the electric drive may be missing in certain eVito vehicles.
remedy: Check affected vehicles for missing screws on the drive unit. Should at least one of the screws be missing replace the front drive module.

concern: IT CANNOT BE GUARANTEED THAT A TIE DOWN EYE WILL NOT BECOME MECHANICALLY OVERLOADED WHEN TIGHTENING A TENSIONING STRAP/CHAIN
defect: It is possible that qualitatively defective tie-down eyes may have been installed on the body platform of these vehicles
remedy: Replace the tie-down eyes on the potentially affected vehicles

concern: ENGINE WIRING LOOM MAY TOUCH A STUD ON THE TRANSMISSION HOUSING
defect: Engine wiring loom may touch a stud on the transmission housing
remedy: Transmission stud to be replaced with a bolt and rerouting of the wiring loom

concern: THE ELECTRIC PARKING BRAKE CAN BE UNINTENTIONALLY RELEASED WHEN DISENGAGING THE CLUTCH PEDAL
defect: The electric parking brake can be unintentionally released when disengaging the clutch pedal.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the brake control unit has to be recoded

concern: THE DRIVE CLUTCH STATIONARY SHEAVE MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED INCORRECTLY
defect: Some 2020 RANGER XP 1000 and RANGER Diesel vehicles may have been produced with a drive clutch stationary sheave that was manufactured incorrectly.
remedy: Inspect and measure drive clutch components. Replace the EBS sleeve if required.

concern: CRACKS MAY APPEAR AROUND THE REAR LEAF SPRING BUSH EYE
defect: Cracks may appear around the rear leaf spring bush eye.
remedy: Replace the rear leaf springs and handbrake cable.

concern: THE TRANSMISSION MAY EXPERIENCE A BUILD UP OF PRESSURE AND HEAT INSIDE THE TRANSMISSION
defect: Expelled transmission fluid may come in contact with the turbocharger or other ignition sources within the engine compartment and lead to a vehicle fire
remedy: Replace the transmission valve body separator plate and reprogram the Powertrain Control Module.

concern: THE OCCUPANT RESTRAINT CONTROL MODULE (ORC) MAY INADVERTENTLY DEPLOY THE AIRBAGS AND/OR SEAT BELT PRETENSIONERS
defect: The Occupant Restraint Control (ORC) module may inadvertently deploy the airbags and/or seat belt pretensioners
remedy: Replace the ORC module

concern: THE FOLDABLE REAR CENTRE HEAD RESTRAINT INTERLOCK WAS NOT WELDED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The rear center head restraint interlock was not welded according to specification.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the center rear head restraint will be replaced.

concern: A MISROUTED FRONT BRAKE HOSE MAY DAMAGE IGNITION SWITCH WIRING
defect: A misrouted front brake hose may damage ignition switch wiring.
remedy: Check the hose and cable routing repair as necessary.

concern: INCORRECT HEAT SHRINK TUBING ON THE BATTERY POSITIVE CABLE TERMINAL/HARNESS
defect: Incorrect heat shrink tubing on the battery positive cable terminal/harness connected to the fuse board.
remedy: Check and rectify the heat shrink tubing on the cable terminal/harness if necessary.

concern: THE MATERIAL COMPOSITION OF THE GAS SYSTEM HIGH PRESSURE REGULATOR IS OUT OF SPECIFICATION
defect: The material composition of the gas system high pressure regulator has been found to be outside of specification.
remedy: Check the component serial number and renew the high pressure regulator if it is in the defined batch of defective components.

concern: MALFUNCTION IN THE HEAT EXCHANGER FOR THE LNG FUEL TANK HEATING
defect: Malfunctions in the heat exchanger for the LNG fuel tank heating may result in very cold liquefied gas reaching components that are not designed to withstand such low temperatures.
remedy: Carry out a software update to Engine and Gas Management systems creating control measures and a warning light in the event of a fault occurring.

concern: THE HEAD RESTRAINTS OF THE LUXURY BENCH SEATS IN THE REAR MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED INCORRECTLY
defect: Bench seats in the rear may have been installed with the head restraint bars of a different bench seat and/or head restraint variant.
remedy: Check the head restraints in the rear area in the affected vehicles and replace if necessary.

concern: THE HEAD RESTRAINT PADDING MAY SEPARATE FROM THE FASTENING RODS
defect: The head restraint padding may separate from the fastening rod.
remedy: Replace the head restraints on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE ELECTRIC MOTOR ELECTRONICS PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD WAS NOT MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO THE SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The Electric Motor Electronics (EME) printed circuit board was not manufactured according to specifications
remedy: The Electric Motor Electronics (EME) of vehicles affected will be replaced.

concern: THE GEAR POSITION SWITCH MAY PROVIDE AN INACCURATE SIGNAL
defect: The gear position switch may provide an inaccurate signal.
remedy: Replace the gear position switch on impacted models

concern: DURING ASSEMBLY THE ENGINE OUTPUT SHAFT BEARING MAY NOT HAVE HAD ADEQUATE INITIAL LUBRICATION
defect: The engine output shaft bearing may not have had adequate initial lubrication during assembly
remedy: Disassemble and apply required lubricant in the engine output shaft housing

concern: THE BRAKE MECHANISM SUPPORT COULD BREAK AND CAUSE TOTAL LOSS OF BRAKING CAPACITY
defect: The brake pedal mount could break during an emergency stop and cause a total loss of braking capacity.
remedy: Install a bracket to secure the brake mechanism to the rear footrest support.

concern: THE STEERING GEAR TIE ROD MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ASSEMBLED WITH THE REQUIRED SPHERICAL WASHER
defect: The steering gear tie rod may not have been assembled with a required spherical washer
remedy: Both steering gear tie rods will be checked and if affected tie rod/s and accompanying swivel bearing/s will be replaced

concern: POSSIBLE MATERIAL NONCONFORMITY OF THE BRAKE LINE
defect: A possible material nonconformity of the rear brake line
remedy: Replace the brake line leading from the rear brake caliper to the ABS modulator.

concern: THE REAR LOWER SHOCK ABSORBER MOUNTING BOLT MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE CORRECT TORQUE SETTING
defect: The rear lower shock absorber mounting bolt might not be tightened to the correct torque setting
remedy: The campaign requires the bolt to be loosened and re-torqued to the correct setting

concern: THE FIXINGS OF THE HIGH LEVEL 3RD BRAKE LIGHT COULD COME LOOSE
defect: The 3rd brake light may not be correctly secured to the vehicle.
remedy: Connections of the 3rd brake light will be reworked new nuts will be fitted with thread locking agent applied to the threads to prevent them coming loose.

concern: THE TIGHTENING OF THE REAR SUSPENSION FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
defect: The tightening of some rear suspension fixings may not be correct to specification
remedy: Correcting some tightening torques and replacing some nuts and bolts.

concern: POSSIBLE NON CONFORMITY OF SEALS IN FRONT WHEEL ARCHES COULD LEAD TO WATER INGRESS INTO CERTAIN ELECTRONIC UNITS
defect: Possible non-conformity of certain seals in the front wheel arches could lead to water ingress into the passenger compartment.
remedy: Resealing these areas checking for the presence of water in the passenger compartment and replacing certain components in the interior if required

concern: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS LOWER BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
defect: The tightening and positioning of the seat belt lower bolts may be incorrect.
remedy: This campaign consists of checking and if necessary correcting both the position of the bolt and the tightening torque of all of the lower fixings of the seat belts.

concern: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS AND ONE GROUND CABLE MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
defect: The tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables may not conform to specification.
remedy: Tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables

concern: NON-CONFORMITY OF THE REAR BRAKE CALLIPERS
defect: A non-conformity of the rear brake callipers could reduce the efficiency of the parking brake
remedy: Check and if necessary replace the callipers.

concern: FUEL TUBES UNDER BODY MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME
defect: The fuel pipes under the body may have been damaged over time due to a relative movement between these pipes and their surroundings
remedy: Check the condition of the fuel pipes and replacing them if necessary. New protection will be fitted on all vehicles to prevent this damage in the future.

concern: THE REAR BRAKE HOSES MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THESE HOSES AND A CLIP
defect: The rear brake hoses may have been damaged over time due to inappropriate movement between these hoses and a clip.
remedy: Check the condition of the rear left-hand and right-hand brake hoses and replacing them if necessary. A new retaining clip is fitted on all vehicles to prevent this relative movement.

concern: THERE MAY BE INCREASED PEDAL TRAVEL AS A RESULT OF PRODUCTION TOLERANCES
defect: There may be increased pedal travel as a result of production tolerances
remedy: The brake calliper housing (with actuator motor) must be replaced on the vehicles affected

concern: THE REAR BRAKE HOSE MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THE HOSE AND HOLDING CLIP
defect: There is a possibility that the rear brake hose may become damaged due to relative movement between the hose and the holding clip.
remedy: Check the condition of the left and right rear brake hoses and replace them if necessary.

concern: TIGHTENING OF REAR SUSPENSION FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
defect: The tightening of some rear suspension fixings may not be correct to specification.
remedy: Correcting some tightening torques and replacing some nuts and bolts.

concern: POSSIBLE NON CONFORMITY OF SEALS IN FRONT WHEEL ARCHES COULD LEAD TO WATER INGRESS INTO CERTAIN ELECTRONIC UNITS
defect: Possible non-conformity of certain seals in the front wheel arches could lead to water ingress into the passenger compartment.
remedy: Resealing these areas checking for the presence of water in the passenger compartment and replacing certain components in the interior if required.

concern: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS LOWER BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
defect: The tightening and positioning of the seat belt lower bolts may be incorrect.
remedy: This campaign consists of checking and if necessary correcting both the position of the bolt and the tightening torque of all of the lower fixings of the seat belts.

concern: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS AND ONE GROUND CABLE MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
defect: The tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables may not conform to specification
remedy: Tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables.

concern: NON-CONFORMITY OF THE REAR BRAKE CALIPERS
defect: A non-conformity of the rear brake callipers could reduce the efficiency of the parking brake.
remedy: Check and if necessary replace the callipers

concern: FUEL TUBES UNDER BODY MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME
defect: The fuel pipes under the body may have been damaged over time due to a relative movement between these pipes and their surroundings.
remedy: Check the condition of the fuel pipes and replacing them if necessary. New protection will be fitted on all vehicles to prevent this damage in the future.

concern: THE REAR BRAKE HOSES MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THESE HOSES AND A CLIP
defect: The rear brake hoses may have been damaged over time due to inappropriate movement between these hoses and a clip.
remedy: Check the condition of the rear left-hand and right-hand brake hoses and replacing them if necessary. A new retaining clip is fitted on all vehicles to prevent this relative movement.

concern: THE BRAKE SERVO PULL ROD BALL COUPLING MAY HAVE BEEN PUT INTO THE MOUNTING OF THE BRAKE PEDAL INCORRECTLY
defect: The ball coupling of the push rod of the electromechanical brake servo may have been wrongly slotted into the mounting on the brake pedal.
remedy: Check the ball coupling into the mounting of the brake pedal. If the ball coupling is incorrectly slotted in the brake servo and mounting in the brake pedal must be replaced.

concern: IN THE EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT THE FUEL TANK COULD BE DAMAGED AND LEAK
defect: The fuel tank could be damaged and leak in the event of an accident.
remedy: A component protector must be fitted to a bracket on the body of the vehicles affected.

concern: THE E-CALL FUNCTION MAY NOT WORK CORRECTLY
defect: Due to a fault of the software of the OCU control unit (Online Connectivity Unit) the e-call function may work incorrectly.
remedy: An update of the software of the OCU control unit has to be carried out.

concern: THE CURRENT ENGINE CONTROL UNIT CALIBRATION MAY PREVENT THE THROTTLE PLATES FROM RETURNING TO IDLE POSITION
defect: Engine Control Unit (ECU) calibration may prevent the throttle plates from returning to idle position after an engine stalling.
remedy: Updating ECU calibrations of the affected vehicles.

concern: THIRD ROW SEAT BELT PILLAR D-LOOP UPPER ANCHORAGES MAY NOT FULFILL LEGAL REQUIREMENTS
defect: The third row seat belt pillar D-loop upper anchorages may not fulfil the legal load requirements
remedy: Replace the existing 14x26 mm bolt used to attach the seat belt D-loop with a 14x40mm bolt.

concern: AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKING SYSTEM WILL NOT OPERATE BETWEEN 10 AND 40 DEG C
defect: Under abnormal operation the AEB (Automatic Emergency Braking) feature will not operate between 10 to 40 deg C.
remedy: Install a software improvement.

concern: THE REAR SPOILER ATTACHED TO THE TOP EDGE OF THE TAILGATE ADJOINING THE REAR OF THE ROO CAN BE INADEQUATELY BONDED ON THE RIGHT HAND SIDE
defect: The rear spoiler attached to the top edge of the tailgate adjoining the rear of the roof can be inadequately bonded on the Right Hand side
remedy: Check for correct adhesion and replace if faulty

concern: ONE OR BOTH LED DAYTIME RUNNING LAMPS MAY FLICKER FLASH OR FAIL COMPLETELY
defect: One or both LED daytime Running Lamps may flicker flash or fail completely.
remedy: Replace sealing gaskets and install gas absorbing sheets on affected units that operate normally. Replace any faulty units.

concern: THE DATA VERSION OF THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT MUST BE UPDATED TO IMPROVE THE NITROGEN OXIDE EMISSIONS
defect: The affected vehicle may not meet prescribed emission limits.
remedy: The engine control unit must be updated in order to improve the engine control system.

concern: THE STOP SCREWS FOR THE PIN BETWEEN THE FIFTH WHEEL PLATE AND PEDESTAL MIGHT BE MISSING
defect: The stop screws for the pin between the fifth wheel plate and pedestal might be missing.
remedy: Fit the stop screws where required

concern: THE INSTRMENT CLUSTER MAY BECOME NON-OPERATIONAL.
defect: The instrument cluster may become non-operational
remedy: Reprogram the instrument cluster

concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH THE INCORRECT TWIN BATTERY POSITIVE CABLE
defect: Vehicles may have been fitted with the wrong twin battery positive cable.
remedy: Inspect affected vehicles install a new twin battery cable and correct the cable routing if the concern is identified.

concern: THE ELECTRIC CHILD LOCK MAY NOT BE MECHANICALLY LOCKED ALTHOUGH SWITCHED ON BY DRIVER
defect: Under very specific conditions the electric child lock is not mechanically locked although it has been switched on by the driver.
remedy: On the affected vehicles the software of the on-board supply control unit has to be reconfigured.

concern: THE ENGINE OIL MAY POSSIBLY REACH THE BRAKE SERVO THROUGH THE VACUUM HOSE
defect: It is possible that engine oil reaches the brake servo through the vacuum hose from the tandem pump to the brake servo.
remedy: The vacuum line from the tandem pump is replaced. It must also be checked whether other components have come into contact with oil and therefore need to be replaced too.

concern: BOLTED CONNECTION BETWEEN STEERING SHAFT AND STEERING RACK MAY LOOSEN
defect: The bolted connection between the steering shaft and the steering rack may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
remedy: The bolted connection of the intermediate steering shaft has to be replaced

concern: BOLTED CONNECTION BETWEEN STEERING SHAFT AND STEERING RACK MAY COME LOOSE
defect: The bolted connection between the steering shaft and the steering rack may not have been tightened to the required torque
remedy: The bolted connection between the steering shaft and the steering rack will be checked and if necessary replaced.

concern: VEHICLES WITH AN INTEGRATED BACKUP BATTERY HAVE BEEN DELIVERED WITHOUT A SEAT BASE COVER
defect: Vehicles fitted with an auxiliary battery installed under the right front seat may have been delivered without a seat base cover
remedy: Retro-fit the seat box cover to the affected vehicles

concern: CRYSTALLIZATION IN SILENCER AND ACTIVE MIL WITH ENGINE DERATE
defect: Crystallization in silencer and active MIL with engine derate.
remedy: Update EMS and ACM software.

concern: THE FINAL PART OF THE VEHICLE VERSION DISPLAYED ON THE MANUFACTURER LABEL ON THE A PILLAR CONTAINS INCORRECT VERSION INFORMATION
defect: Incorrect sticker shows data M1561F4 5W correct version is M1561F 4APD.
remedy: Replacement of the sticker label.

concern: SOFTWARE ISSUE MEANS THAT AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT ENGAGE
defect: The Automatic Emergency Brake System a function of the IntelliSafe system may not always engage increasing the risk of a collision
remedy: Affected vehicles must have new software downloaded

concern: ONE OF THE NUTS SECURING THE BRAKE BOOSTER TO THE FIREWALL IS MISSING.
defect: On affected vehicles one of the nuts securing the brake booster to the firewall is missing
remedy: Fit the missing nut.

concern: OIL MAY GET INTO THE BRAKE SERVO THROUGH THE VACUUM LINES OF THE TANDEM PUMP.
defect: Oil may get into the brake servo through the vacuum lines of the tandem pump leading to a loss of braking assistance.
remedy: Replace the vacuum line from the tandem pump. Check other components for oil and replace if necessary.

concern: IN THE EVENT OF DEPLOYMENT THE AIR BAG MAY NOT INFLATE PROPERLY
defect: The absorption of moisture into the driver�s airbag propellant could lead to slow deployment or inflator rupture.
remedy: Replace the airbag inflator or the airbag assembly. Suzuki is still preparing for the development and production of the remedy parts.

concern: THE PIVOT PIN MATERIAL DOES NOT HAVE THE CORRECT QUALITY AND THE YIELD STRENGTH IS NOT SUFFICIENT
defect: The material of the pivot pin which connects the swinging arm to the rear bevel gear does not have the correct quality
remedy: On affected bikes the pivot pin will be replaced. Furthermore the repair manual will be revised as the pivot pins needs to be replaced by any related repair.

concern: THE SPRING DAMPER SOFTWARE MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
defect: The spring damper software might not meet specification affecting level sensors and headlight range.
remedy: Replace the spring damper control unit on affected vehicles.

concern: CERTAIN THREADED CONNECTIONS ON THE LEFT/RIGHT WHEEL CARRIER ON THE REAR AXLE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN IMPLEMENTED CORRECTLY
defect: Threaded connections on the left/right wheel carrier on the rear axle of certain vehicles may not have been implemented correctly
remedy: Check the threaded connections and if necessary replace wheel carriers and/or brake caliper supports on the rear axle

concern: A WELD SEAM ON THE SEAT HEIGHT ADJUSTMENT MECHANISM MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
defect: A weld seam on the seat height adjustment mechanism may not have been carried out in accordance with specifications
remedy: Replace the seat-frame bases of the front seats in the affected vehicles

concern: THE REAR AXLE STEEL LEAF SPRINGS MAY NOT MEET ALL REQUIREMENTS FOR STRENGTH DURING OPERATION
defect: The rear axle steel leaf springs may not meet all requirements for strength during operation
remedy: Check if the rear axle springs on the affected vehicles are a part of an affected production batch and replace them if necessary

concern: THE STEERING SHAFT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY ALIGNED WITH THE STEERING GEAR
defect: The steering shaft may not have been correctly aligned with the steering gear during production.
remedy: Replace the steering shaft and pinch bolt.

concern: DRAW BAR MAY HAVE MOVEMENT IF LOAD IS SECURED INCORRECTLY
defect: Draw bar attached to light board may have movement if load is secured incorrectly and light board may become detached
remedy: Fit a revised longer clamping bar

concern: MOISTURE COULD ENTER THE AIRBAG INFLATOR CAUSING THE PROPELLNT TO DEGRADE
defect: The absorption of moisture into the driver�s airbag propellant could lead to slow deployment or inflator rupture.
remedy: Replace the airbag inflator or the airbag assembly. Mazda is still preparing for the development and production of the remedy parts.

concern: IMPROPER ASSEMBLY OF THE ELECTRICAL CONTACTS IN THE DRIVER'S SEAT BELT REMINDER SWITCH
defect: An improper assembly of the electrical contacts in the reminder switch for the driver seat belt
remedy: Replace driver side seat inner belt.

concern: DRIVER'S FRONT TAKATA (NADI) AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE ON DEPLOYMENT
defect: Drivers air bag may deploy incorrectly
remedy: Replace the air bag inflators.

concern: BOTTOM SIDE OF FUEL PUMP SERVI CE COVER MAY GET INTO CONTACT WITH CONNECTION PIPE OF THE FUEL PUMP
defect: The fuel pump connection pipe may come into contact with the fuel pump service cover and become damaged
remedy: Re-work the bottom of the service cover

concern: UNEXPECTED LOSS OF FORWARD LIGHTING
defect: An electrical defect may exist on Indian Motorcycle MY 2014 resulting in the unexpected loss of forward lighting.
remedy: Inspect the VCM connector for damage repair as necessary & reflash the VCM.

concern: THE CONNECTIONS OF THE CENTRAL POWER SUPPLY AND THE EARTH CABLE OF THE ASAM CONTROL UNIT MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY ENGAGED
defect: The connections of the ASAM control unit may not be correctly engaged.
remedy: Check the engagement of the connectors on affected vehicles and correct where required

concern: SEATBELTS MAY STICK WHEN PULLED OUT OR RETRACTED
defect: On affected vehicles certain seat belts might stick when pulled out and retracted.
remedy: Replace the affected seat belts on the affected vehicles.

concern: THE RESIN SPACERS COULD BE DEFORMED BY HEAT CAUSING THE ENGINE CYLINDER HEAD BOLTS TO BECOME LOOSE
defect: A loss of injector sealing and resulting in fuel leakage.
remedy: Replace the injector spacer and bolts with new ones of the correct specification

concern: THE REAR SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY SPRING MAY BE INSTALLED IN AN INCORRECT POSITION
defect: Possible improper adjustment in the webbing sensor locking mechanism during assembly
remedy: Inspect and replace the seat belt if necessary.

concern: THE ISOFIX CHILD RESTRAINT U-LOOP MAY BREAK OFF THE CARRIER PLATE
defect: The ISOFIX child restraint U-Loop may break off the carrier plate resulting in the child seat no longer being secure.
remedy: Weld an additional metal angle bracket to each ISOFIX U-Loop

concern: THE SEALING OF THE ROOF DRIVER AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM COULD BE INSUFFICIENT
defect: Water can enter in the vehicle interior via the roof mounting point through the connections of the roof module of the air conditioning for the driver's area.
remedy: Apply an additional sealing bead as a barrier around the roof mounting point.

concern: THE AIR BAG MAY DEPLOY PREMATURELY
defect: In the event of an impact on the lower part of the vehicle body the airbag may prematurely deploy
remedy: The airbag Control Unit will be reprogrammed

concern: THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REGULATED REQUIREMENTS
defect: The Telematics Service Delivery Platform has incorrectly configured the in-vehicle eCall phone number.
remedy: Update the Telematics Service Delivery Platform.

concern: THE TRANSMISSION WIRING HARNESS MAY HAVE INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE WITH THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER
defect: Insufficient clearance for the transmission wiring harness
remedy: Inspect the harness for damage and replace if necessary.

concern: THREADED CONNECTIONS AT THE STEERING BRACKET OF THE STEERING GEAR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY SECURED
defect: One or more threaded connections of the steering bracket may not have been correctly secured.
remedy: Check loosen and correctly apply the required tightening torque to the affected connections.

concern: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT
defect: Premature degradation of emission control component.
remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer.

concern: ONE OR MORE OF THE FASTENERS ON THE RIGHT HAND FRONT SEAT FRAME ASSEMBLY MAY BE MISSING OR INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED
defect: The fasteners on the right hand front seat frame may be missing or incorrectly assembled.
remedy: Replace the right hand front seat.

concern: IN THE EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT THE AIR DUCT COMPONENT IN THE CURTAIN AIRBAG COULD DETACH
defect: The fastener securing an air duct component in the curtain airbag could detach in the event of an accident.
remedy: Replace the igniter on the affected vehicles curtain airbags.

concern: CURTAIN AIRBAG UNITS MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH THE GAS GENERATOR WELDED TO THE OUTLET PIPE WHICH IS NOT FAIL PROOF
defect: The curtain airbag unit gas generators may not be fail-proof leading to the airbags not opening completely in the event of an accident.
remedy: Replace affected airbag units.

concern: THE TURBO CHARGER OIL RETURN PIPE MAY CRACK AND LEAK ENGINE OIL
defect: The turbo charger oil return pipe may get damaged by cracks which may lead to oil leaks.
remedy: Replace the oil return pipes on affected vehicles

concern: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT
defect: Premature degradation of emission control component.
remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer.

concern: THE eCALL FUNCTION MAY BE REDUCED DUE TO A FAULT IN THE DATA COMMUNICATION
defect: The eCall function may be reduced.
remedy: The OCU unit of the vehicles affected has to be restarted

concern: CERTAIN REAR SUSPENSION FIXING BOLTS MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION
defect: Certain rear suspension fixing bolts may not conform to specification which could cause them to break
remedy: Replace the affected bolts.

concern: CERTAIN REAR SUSPENSION FIXING BOLTS MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION
defect: Certain rear suspension fixing bolts may not conform to specification which could cause them to break.
remedy: Replace the affected bolts

concern: THE MOVEABLE CONTACT TERMINAL PLATING FOR THE HORN AND STARTER SWITCH HAS BEEN IMPROPERLY COATED
defect: The contact terminal for the Horn and Starter switch has been improperly coated and may fail.
remedy: Replacement of the horn and starter switch assemblies

concern: WATER MAY ENTER CABIN THROUGH FRONT LEFT AND RIGHT WHEEL ARCH AREAS
defect: Water could enter the cabin through the panels in front left and right wheel arch areas affecting electrical components
remedy: Inspect for water leak and replace affected parts if necessary and apply sealant to close the gap between the affected body panels.

concern: SOME SEAT BELT FIXATION BOLTS WERE NOT TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
defect: There is a possibility that some seat belt fixation bolts were not tightened correctly.
remedy: Inspect and tighten affected bolts to correct torque.

concern: SOME SEAT BELT FIXATION BOLTS AND/OR GROUND CABLE BOLTS WERE NOT TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
defect: There is a possibility that some seat belt fixation bolts and/or ground cable bolts were not tightened correctly.
remedy: Tighten affected bolts to correct torque and replace the ground cable if it is damaged.

concern: FUEL TUBE MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME AND FUEL MAY LEAK
defect: The fuel tube may become damaged due to movement between the tube and ribs on the urea tank.
remedy: Install protection sleeves and replace the fuel tube if necessary

concern: PARKING BRAKE SHAFT MAY BE OUTSIDE OF SPECIFICATION
defect: There is a possibility that the parking brake was manufactured with a shaft outside of specification
remedy: Inspect and replace the brake calliper if necessary

concern: REAR BRAKE TUBE MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME
defect: The rear brake tube may become damaged over time due to movement between tube and holding clip on the lower suspension arm.
remedy: Inspect and replace the brake tube if necessary

concern: THE HOLDER BRAKE HOSES 3 AND 4 COULD DETACH FROM THE FRONT FORK BRACKET
defect: A Brake hose may touch the front fork outer tube and could wear out.
remedy: The affected units should have the brake hose brackets replaced by countermeasure ones.

concern: POSSIBLE WEAR TO BRAKE HOSE 1 BY RUBBING TO HORN LEAD WIRE
defect: A brake hose has a possibility to wear by rubbing to horn lead wire.
remedy: The affected units should have the horn lead wire re-routed according to new specifications.

concern: SUDDEN LOSS OF BRAKE PERFORMANCE
defect: The brake booster diaphragm plate can crack causing the internal membrane to split and leading to sudden loss of brake performance.
remedy: Replace the brake booster (servo).

concern: BOLTS SECURING THE FUEL RAIL TO THE CYCLINDER HEAD MAY FAIL.
defect: Bolts securing the fuel rail to the cylinder head may fail.
remedy: The spacers and fuel rail securing bolts will be replaced with new revised parts

concern: THE MAIN STAND STRENGTH IS INSUFFICIENT
defect: The main stand strength is insufficient.
remedy: The affected units need to have the main stand replaced with a countermeasure version.

concern: THE HANDBRAKE MAY NOT HOLD THE VEHICLE IN PLACE
defect: There is a risk the handbrake may not hold the vehicle in place due to a non-conformity of the rear brake calipers
remedy: Check the manufacturing markings on the Left and Right Rear Brake Calipers and if necessary replace them

concern: THE SPRING PIN OF THE HEAD RESTRAINT OF THE SEAT OR BENCH MAY BE MISSING OR NOT PROPERLY MOUNTED
defect: The head restraints in the rear may have been installed with an incorrect substructure including the head restraint bars.
remedy: Check the headrests on the affected vehicles and replace them if necessary.

concern: HAZARD LIGHTS FAIL TO OPERATE WHEN IGNITION KEY IS DISENGAGED
defect: Hazard warning lights do not work with the ignition turned off and the key removed.
remedy: Installation of a separate 12v supply.

concern: SOME OF THE FIXINGS OF THE SECOND ROW SEAT FRAME ASSEMBLY MAY BE MISSING
defect: Second row seat fixings missing
remedy: Replace the second row seat frame and ensure the fixings are tightened correctly

concern: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE IGNITION CAN BE AUTOMATICALLY SWITCHED OFF WHILST THE VEHICLE IS BEING DRIVEN
defect: When using an auxiliary starter facility there is a risk that the ignition can be automatically switched off while the vehicle is being driven.
remedy: Change the switch-off time by means of a software change.

concern: AIRBAG RETENTION SPRINGS MAY NOT LOCK AIRBAG TO STEERING WHEEL
defect: The driver�s airbag retention springs maybe outside of manufacturing specification and may not lock the module to the steering wheel
remedy: Install a replacement airbag retention spring.

concern: THE ELECTRIC PUMP INVERTER SHUTS OFF WHEN THE IGNITION IS SWITCHED OFF EVEN IF THE VEHICLE IS MOVING
defect: The Electric Steering Pump inverter shuts off when the ignition is switched off even if the vehicle is moving.
remedy: Change to wiring to keep the EHPS function on when the vehicle is moving with ignition switched off.

concern: THE ELECTRIC STEERING PUMP INVERTER SHUTS OFF WHEN THE IGNITION IS SWITCHED OFF EVEN IF THE VEHICLE IS MOVING
defect: The Electric Steering Pump inverter shuts off when the ignition is switched off even if the vehicle is moving.
remedy: Change the steering pump wiring.

concern: THE ROUTING OF THE REAR BRAKE PIPES MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION
defect: The routing of the rear brake pipes may not be correct and could cause them to fail.
remedy: Check and replace affected pipes if necessary

concern: THE ROUTING OF THE REAR BRAKE PIPES MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION
defect: The routing of the rear brake pipes may not be correct and could cause them to fail.
remedy: Check and replace affected pipes if necessary

concern: WATER INGRESS THROUGH WHEEL ARCHES INTO PASSENGER COMPARTMENT
defect: Water ingress into the passenger compartment due to poor wheel arch sealing may lead to airbag malfunction
remedy: Seal the wheel arch body seams. Replace wiring harness and airbag control unit if necessary

concern: SEVERAL REAR AXLE FASTENING BOLTS NEED TO BE REPLACED
defect: Rear axle bolts may break or become loose
remedy: Check the fastening torque and replace affected bolts on all affected vehicles

concern: WATER INGRESS THROUGH WHEEL ARCHES INTO PASSENGER COMPARTMENT
defect: Water ingress into the passenger compartment due to poor wheel arch sealing may lead to airbag malfunction
remedy: Seal the wheel arch body seams. Replace wiring harness and airbag control unit if necessary

concern: THE SIDE STAND SPRING MAY FRACTURE
defect: A side stand spring may fracture with the stand leg in its rest (up) position
remedy: Replace the side stand spring.

concern: THE RIGIDITY OF THE REAR SHOCK ABSORBER FORKS MAY BE IMPAIRED
defect: The rigidity of the rear shock absorber forks may be impaired
remedy: Replace the rear shock absorber forks on affected vehicles

concern: THE CLIP OF A FUEL LINE BUNDLE MIGHT CHAFE AGAINST THE FUEL PUMP
defect: The clip of a fuel line bundle might chafe against the fuel pump hose.
remedy: Check the hose routing turn the clip by 180�. Replace the hose and add a grommet to the fuel hose if necessary.

concern: THE FUEL TANK WALLS MAY NOT BE TO THE CORRECT THICKNESS
defect: The specified wall thickness of the fuel tank can in some places fall below the threshold.
remedy: For all affected vehicles the fuel tank has to be replaced

concern: THE REAR BRAKE CALIPER HANDBRAKE LEVER PIVOT PIN MAY BREAK DURING HANDBRAKE OPERATION
defect: The rear brake caliper handbrake lever pivot pin may break during handbrake operation

remedy: On affected vehicles replace the current retainer with a new version to ensure the sleeve connection between intercooler sleeve and throttle body.

remedy: An affected brake booster can be identified by its date of manufacture. This can be found on a label on the brake booster. An affected brake booster must be removed and replaced a new one.

This may affect the…
remedy: On affected vehicles check condition and routing of affected looms. Where necessary repair and re-route looms according to manufacturer's instructions.

concern: SUPPLEMENTARY RESTRAINT SYSTEM (SRS) MAY NOT PERFORM AS INTENDED IN A COLLISION
defect: The calibration of the Restraints control Module does not provide the correct fire signals in the event of a collision. remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and download the correct software to the vehicle.

concern: STEERING COLUMN JOINT MAY NOT BE SECURE
defect: The Steering column may become detached from the rack due to incorrectly tightened bolt
remedy: On affected vehicles check for presence of retaining nut. If present tighten nut to specified torque. If nut is absent replace bolt and screw and tighten to specified torque. THE MANUFACTURER HAS ADVISED NOT TO DRIVE THE VEHICLE.

concern: BATTERY MAY FAIL TO CHARGE WHICH COULD CAUSE ENGINE TO STALL AND LIGHTS TO FADE

If the car is driven continuously in this condition the lead-acid battery will not be charged. In the worst case there is…
remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and reprogramme the ECM with corrected software.

concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
defect: The brazing of the fuel rail end caps is inconsistent and may not correctly seal the fuel rail ends. Fuel vapour and liquid fuel leaks can occur over time. This can lead to a liquid fuel leak into the engine bay.
remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuel rail with a correctly manufactured version.

concern: OIL SUMP MAY CRACK DUE TO THE ENGINE OVERHEATING

remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and download revised software for the control module calibration that improves overheat detection and provides an instrument cluster warning indicator to the driver and engine de-rate strategy.

concern: REAR SPRING LOWER LEAF MAY BREAK AND DETACH
defect: Due to a fault in the manufacturing process the lower leaf of the parabolic spring may break. The leaf may detach and fall on to the road surface.
remedy: On affected vehicles examine spring and where necessary replace leaves.

concern: BRAKE AND/OR CLUTCH SYSTEM COMPONENTS MAY BECOME DAMAGED BY MINERAL OIL
defect: The brake/clutch system components may be damaged and system performance may decay as a result of the potential presence of mineral oil in the brake-clutch fluid because the components are not compatible with mineral oil. As a result brake/clutch system performance may deteriorate.
remedy: Replace the components in the brake-clutch system.

concern: CONNECTION IN FUSE BOX MAY BE INSECURE
defect: The bus bar of the fuse panel on the power distribution board (PDB) could be loose. This may cause faults in circuits associated with the fuse board circuits.
remedy: Check the PDB production period and if necessary replace the screws with new ones.

concern: KEY INFORMATION ABOUT PASSEGER PROTECTION SYSTEMS IS NOT INCLUDED IN OWNER'S MANUAL
defect: Owner's Manuals with incomplete information about the restraint system were delivered. Warnings instructions and information for 'Proactive Passenger Protection System' 'Airbag System' and 'Transporting Children Safely' are missing from the Owner's Manual. Without correct instruction it is…
remedy: Notify the vehicle owners so a supplement can be be added to the Owner�s Manual.

concern: REPLACE FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG
defect: The front passenger airbag may be faulty. There may be insufficient protection especially for smaller passengers in the front seat because of incorrectly folded passenger airbags.
remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger airbag.

remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger airbag.

defect: If the brake fluid has not been changed as per manufacturer's instructions deposits may form which may affect the operation of the ABS module. Continued use may lead to loss of braking.
remedy: On affected vehicles flush the brake systems and replace with an uprated specification fluid.

concern: FUEL FILTER SUPPORT MAY BREAK
defect: The fuel filter support bracket may crack and the fuel filter could become insecure As a result the fuel filter and or fuel tube may leak.
remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuel filter support bracket Check condition of filter and fuel tube. Replace if necessary

concern: INSTRUMENT CLUSTER MAY DISPLAY INCORRECT INFORMATION

remedy: On affected vehicles replace the instrument cluster.

defect: In the event that the airbag is activated it may overinflate due to overly aggressive combustion of the propellant. As a result the excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing severe injury to the rider.
remedy: On affected machines replace the airbag assembly.

concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY

defect: The screws retaining the catalytic converter bracket on the engine bracket may have an incorrect clench. This could lead to vibration and cause the exhaust to crack.
remedy: On affected vehicles check screws according to manufacturer's procedures..Depending on findings either replace screws or refer to manufacturer for further guidance

concern: BONDING OF THE WINDSHIELD MAY BE INADEQUATE

remedy: On affected vehicles check bonding and if necessary replace windscreen.

concern: DRIVER'S DOOR PANEL MAY DETACH
defect: The bonding on the panelling under driver's window may be incorrect and the panel could detach.
remedy: On affected vehicles replace the panel with a correctly bonded version.

concern: AUXILLIARY HEATER ELEMENT IN AIR CONDITIONING MAY FAIL AND/OR OVERHEAT
defect: The auxiliary heater element in the air conditioner may fail as the result of overheating in the area of the connectors. This can lead to smoulder damage or potentially a fire.
remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and change the auxiliary heater element for one with optimised electrical connectors.

concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
defect: The fuel tank shield may foul the fuel supply pipes. Over a period of time this may cause a fuel leak.
remedy: On affected vehicles check condition of fuel pipes and replace where necessary. In addition add extra protection to existing and replacement pipes.

concern: DOOR LATCHING MECHANISM MAY MALFUNCTION IN HOT TEMPERATURES
defect: The locking mechanism in the door latch assembly may not operate properly in high temperatures. As a result the door may latch correctly and may unintentionally open whilst driving.
remedy: A modified assembly is available and depending on vehicle identification number the remedy is to replace either both O/S door latches or on all four doors.

concern: ECU RELAY MAY OVERHEAT AND CAUSE ECU TO MALFUNCTION

remedy: On affected vehicles the engine ECU power relay will be replaced with a new relay.

concern: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT

remedy: On affected vehicles download a new engine management software in order to modify the cooling management parameters to improve the control of the engine operating temperature.

concern: INCORRECT THROTTLE PEDAL FITTED
defect: An incorrect accelerator pedal may be fitted which could cause discomfort or in extreme circumstances the pedal may get suck under the floor mat.
remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the accelerator pedal fitted. Replace the pedal where necessary.

remedy: On affected vehicles inspect and replace the driver's air bag where necessary.

concern: LOSS OF ENGINE POWER
defect: The resistor for the low pressure fuel pump may fail which can cause loss of power and eventually the engine to shut down.
remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the low pressure fuel pump resistor.

concern: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING
